profiles.shortDescription: MICRO DETECTORS is the sensor brand of M.D. Micro Detectors, an Italian manufacturer that has designed and produced sensors for industrial automation and logistics since 1971, with its seat, research and production in Modena. The range covers photoelectric, proximity, ultrasonic and area sensors, safety devices and encoders. The business now trades as Datasensing S.r.l., which merged Datalogic's Sensor & Safety and Machine Vision business unit with M.D. Micro Detectors and adds machine vision cameras and vision processors to the offering.
fullDescription: M.D. Micro Detectors has been designing and manufacturing a wide variety of sensors for industrial automation and logistics since 1971. The company's own brand documentation states that it adopted the name "Diell" in its early years, which became M.D. Micro Detectors in 2000, and that its seat is in Modena, in the Emilia-Romagna region. A commercial branch was opened in Barcelona, Spain in 1991, followed in 2012 by a branch in Tianjin, China, where a unit developing and producing proximity sensor coils was also created.

Research and development and production are carried out in Modena, which the company describes as giving it total control over processes, technology and quality. Since 2011 the organisation has been based on the principles of Lean Thinking, with vertical integration of assembly and support processes carried out entirely in its own plant, and every sensor is tested at least twice before dispatch. Alongside its catalogue products the company offers custom solutions built to a client's individual application requirements. Its brand material records that in 1977 it launched the first M18 photoelectric sensor.

Datasensing was formed by merging Datalogic's Sensor & Safety and Machine Vision business unit with M.D. Micro Detectors, both described on the company overview page as having 50 years of experience and representing the history of sensors in Italy since the early '70s. The combined company develops, manufactures and supplies machine vision, sensor and safety products, stating more than 200 product lines and 22,500 standard and custom part numbers protected by over 100 patents. Its catalogue is organised into sensors (area, capacitive, inductive, photoelectric, ultrasonic and specialities), safety and guidance (safety light curtains, safety sensors, safety control units, safety laser scanners, lidars and encoders) and machine vision (smart cameras, vision processors and cameras), with applications in the industrial automation of manufacturing and intralogistics processes. The company reports headquarters in Italy with offices in Europe, China and the US and a network of distribution partners.

profiles.officialName: WAT Motor Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.
profiles.shortDescription: TEE is an electric motor brand of the Turkish manufacturer WAT Motor Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., whose head office and factory are in Kapaklı, Tekirdağ. The company produces three-phase asynchronous motors in aluminium and cast iron housings, single-phase motors, smoke extraction motors and motion control products including servo motors and drives. Motors are sold under the WAT and TEE brands to OEM manufacturers in Europe and the Americas.
fullDescription: The company was founded in 1965 as Türk General Elektrik Endüstrisi A.Ş. by GE and the Koç Group, with 37% ownership held by Koç Holding. In 1979 Koç Holding acquired full ownership and renamed the business Türk Elektrik Endüstrisi A.Ş. — the origin of the TEE name. Türk Elektrik Endüstrisi later incorporated WAT Elektromekanik Cihazlar ve Motor Sanayi A.Ş., founded in Sultançiftliği in 1970, and in 1999 the TEE operation merged into Arçelik A.Ş. The company has operated as WAT Motor Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. since 2018.

The site states that its WAT Agility in Motion and TEE-branded products, known for their high technology and quality in Europe and the Americas, have been trusted and used for years by many leading multinational OEM manufacturers, and that motors under the TEE and WAT brands are chosen for their advanced technology and durability. Production takes place at the company's head office and factory in Kapaklı, Tekirdağ, in the Çerkezköy area, on a closed area of 20,000 m².

The product range is organised into three-phase aluminium body motors, three-phase cast iron body motors, single-phase motors, smoke extraction motors, the WAT EC Motor Series and motion control technologies, the last covering servo motors, integrated servo motors, custom servo drive systems and micro DC motors. The company also publishes a separate autonomous systems line with autonomous transport products and software. Stated application areas include agricultural and industrial machinery, air compressors and vacuum pumps, heating, ventilation, air conditioning and cooling, material handling and lifting, motion control systems, renewable energy, shipbuilding and marine, and water and waste water management.

profiles.shortDescription: SIMOTOP GROUP SPA is an Italian electric motor company based at Via Ca' Bianca 320 in Castel San Pietro (BO). It specialises in asynchronous three-phase electric motors from 200 kW to 800 kW, medium-voltage motors from 185 kW to 1600 kW and DC motors from 2.2 kW to 1534 kW, offered in efficiency levels IE1, IE2 and IE3. The company was set up by the electric motor manufacturers Shanghai Top Motor Corporation Ltd and Simo Import & Export Corporation Ltd to serve the European market, and it keeps a large just-in-time stock in Europe.
fullDescription: SIMOTOP GROUP SPA is registered at Via Ca' Bianca 320, 40024 Castel San Pietro (BO), Italy, under VAT number 03003740234. The company states that it was created by two of the most important international manufacturers of electric motors, Shanghai Top Motor Corporation Ltd and Simo Import & Export Corporation Ltd, which wanted to satisfy the demands of the European market, offering the top quality of their products as well as a skilled professional team. Shanghai Top Motor Corporation Ltd is named on the site as producing asynchronous three-phase electric motors from 0.06 kW up to 375 kW under the Techtop brand.

The company describes itself as specialised in the production of asynchronous three-phase electric motors from 200 kW up to 800 kW, from 185 kW up to 1600 kW in medium voltage and in DC from 2.2 kW up to 1534 kW. Motors are built in compliance with international standards including IEC, NEMA and GOST; the manufacturers are certified to ISO 9001 and ISO 14000 and the motors carry CSA, UL, CE and CCC certifications among others. Available efficiency levels are IE1, IE2 and IE3, and the site notes that UL certification was obtained for fire pump motors.

On product development the site states that the group's commitment to limiting the environmental impact of its products, in both production and operation, has for years been the basis on which its new motor series were designed, and that it was among the first to put on the market — and hold in stock — the high-efficiency IE2 and IE3 series ahead of the applicable European legislation under IEC 60034-30. Alongside manufacturing the company promotes what it calls the largest just-in-time stock in Europe and publishes a general catalogue, currently in revision 24, in English, Italian and French.

profiles.shortDescription: BOCKWOLDT Antriebstechnik GmbH & Co. KG is a German manufacturer of geared motors and drive motors, based at Venneweg 28 in Gescher. It is one of the eight companies of the HIMMEL technologies group, which states that it has acquired the BOCKWOLDT product range. The drives are used in industrial production and in machine and plant construction, with agriculture named as a significant application area.
fullDescription: The BOCKWOLDT brand is presented on the HIMMEL technologies group site under its own company page, which gives the entity as BOCKWOLDT Antriebstechnik GmbH & Co. KG, Venneweg 28, D-48712 Gescher. The page states: "As a leading-edge group of companies, HIMMEL® technologies has acquired the BOCKWOLDT product range." The company is listed as one of the eight companies making up the group, so the BOCKWOLDT name and product range are today carried by this Gescher entity rather than by the original Bockwoldt company.

On the product side the page states that "BOCKWOLDT drive motors are used in all areas of industrial production as well as in machine and plant construction", and names the agricultural sector as a significant field of application. It describes the products as based upon experience gained and continuously expanded together with customers, and offers bespoke solutions for customer-specific applications, backed by an extensive parts inventory and a repair service for rapid delivery.

The group's own products overview lists BOCKWOLDT® gear motors alongside the HIMMEL® gear motor ranges — helical, parallel-shaft mounted helical, bevel helical and worm gear motors — and states that both brands represent high-performance, durable and efficient drive solutions. The site notes that the group covers the process from design through mechanical component production to final installation, with quality assurance across all operations.

profiles.shortDescription: ALLEN is the product brand for thermal transfer overprinting and hot stamping coding systems built in Germany and sold by ITW Diagraph GmbH of Würzburg. The company states that Allen Coding, a Diagraph subsidiary for over ten years, has been merged into the Diagraph name while the Allen products remain in the range. Current ALLEN machines are the NGT thermal transfer printer series, the XL5000 thermal transfer printer and the S-COMPACT hot stamping machine.
fullDescription: The manufacturer documents the brand transition on its own site: "A NEW NAME Allen Coding has been a subsidiary of Diagraph for over 10 years. During this time we have become a strong team. And a good team doesn't need two names: Goodbye, Allen Coding. Hello Diagraph!" Under the heading "WHAT REMAINS" the page lists "Allen Codings tried and tested products 'Made in Germany'", the team's expertise in technologies, applications and market segments, and long-standing partnerships. Under what is gained it names Diagraph's market experience as a developer and manufacturer of printing systems since 1893, a worldwide network of subsidiaries and partners, and integration into the globally active ITW Group. The operating entity given on the page is ITW Diagraph GmbH, Friedrich-Bergius-Ring 30, 97076 Würzburg.

The ALLEN marque continues on the machines themselves. The thermal transfer printer page states that the systems are produced in Germany and describes the TTO (Thermal Transfer Overprint) range: the ALLEN NGT series, offered as NGT, NGT2 & NGT4 and NGT6 & NGT8, and the ALLEN XL5000. The site states that the Allen NGT currently has the largest print area on the market and that the NGT6 and NGT8 print up to 213 mm print width with high cycle rates and serialisation, often used for packaging films and labels; the XL5000 is described as an entry-level system with a large ribbon capacity, controlled from the production line through an a:touch Lite industrial touch-screen control panel.

The hot stamping side is represented by the ALLEN S-COMPACT. The site describes it as robust and reliable, requiring no software, capable of embossing even without ribbon, suited to very high cycle rates, with a print area up to 50 x 30 mm, and states that hot stamping printers deliver consistent print quality at up to 800 prints per minute using hardened steel engravings — best suited to marking tasks where the print image changes only occasionally. These ALLEN machines sit within the wider Diagraph labelling and coding portfolio (continuous inkjet, thermal inkjet, large character printers, CO2 laser markers, labelling systems, consumables and software) addressed to food, beverage, chemical and industrial products, cosmetics, pharmaceutical, building materials, pallet production and warehouse automation.

profiles.shortDescription: KRANZ–Packungen Kuhrmeier GmbH is a German manufacturer of wear parts for reciprocating compressors, founded in 1906. It develops and produces piston-rod packings, piston and guide rings, pistons, piston rods and suction and discharge valves in cooperation with compressor manufacturers in Germany and abroad. The range covers low-pressure air compressors up to high-pressure machines with operating pressures of up to 3500 bar, and the company also offers an overhaul and repair service.
fullDescription: The company introduces itself as follows: "Die Firma KRANZ–Packungen Kuhrmeier GmbH wurde 1906 gegründet. Seit dieser Zeit befassen wir uns in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den führenden Kompressorherstellern im In- und Ausland mit der Entwicklung und Fertigung von Kolbenstangen-Packungen sowie Kolben- und Führungsringen." It states that in connection with the introduction of high-pressure syntheses, particularly the various ammonia syntheses, the high-pressure packings of its Type K were developed and patented, and that its Packungstype G with various forms of sealing elements formed the basis for the next development steps: solving the sealing problems of unlubricated compressors, the increased use of plastics, and seals for high-pressure compressors with operating pressures of up to 3500 bar.

The product range is described as a wide selection of high-quality components for all types of compressors: packings, valves, high-pressure components, piston and guide rings, pistons, piston rods, a repair service for compressors, and other parts. Packings are produced for lubricated and unlubricated compressors, from simple low-pressure air compressors up to special ultra-high-pressure packings for pressures above 3000 bar, with the housings and the material selection for the sealing rings — including designs for through-flow cooling — laid out for the particular operating conditions and compressor design. The company states that it has manufactured valves for ultra-high-pressure compressors for decades and has continuously extended the programme to supply suction and discharge valves for compressors in all other pressure ranges, in a wide variety of sizes, designs and materials, so that all main wear parts can be obtained from one source.

Alongside manufacturing, the company offers an overhaul and repair service for valves, packings and piston rods regardless of type, design or origin. Valves are dismantled, cleaned, reworked and, where necessary, individual parts replaced, then checked for correct function; packing housings are dismantled, cleaned, reworked, completed with individual housings if required, lapped on the sealing faces and fitted with new sealing elements. The site states certification to DIN EN ISO 9001:2015 and gives the address as Industriestraße 26, 67125 Dannstadt-Schauernheim, Germany.

profiles.shortDescription: Labit metalworks s.r.o. is a Czech engineering company in Vrchlabí that the site presents as the bearer of the tradition of PELIKÁN Vrchlabí, taken over in 2021 under the Labit a.s. holding. Its work covered precision hydraulic elements — hydraulic motors, hydrogenerators, pressure and servo valves and distributors of the former TOS Hydraulika Vrchlabí brand — together with contract metalworking such as CNC turning, milling and grinding. The company's own page states that operations ceased on 31 January 2024.
fullDescription: Labit metalworks s.r.o. (IČO 25269526) is based at Nádražní 470, in the Labit compound in Vrchlabí, Czech Republic, and describes itself as a private enterprise operating under the wing of the Labit a.s. holding. The site states that the company is regarded as the bearer of the rich tradition of PELIKÁN Vrchlabí, a heritage it took over in 2021, and that the activity itself dates back to 1992.

The published scope of work has two parts. The first is the precision manufacture of hydraulic elements continuing the former TOS Hydraulika Vrchlabí brand: hydraulic motors, hydrogenerators, pressure valves, servo valves and distributors. The second is contract metalworking — precise CNC turning and milling, cylindrical, surface and bore grinding, the manufacture of custom tools and fixtures, construction of mechanically driven machines, and components for small hydroelectric power plants. The site frames this around high quality and an innovative approach for domestic and foreign customers.

The same page carries an explicit closure notice: "Společnost Metalworks s.r.o. ukončila ke dni 31.1.2024 činnost" — the company ended its activity as of 31 January 2024 — and leaves only contact details (labit@labit.cz, +420 775 876 958) for enquiries. This profile should therefore be read as a record of a discontinued manufacturer rather than an active supplier.

profiles.officialName: ALEBRO Dosier- und Umwelttechnik e. K.
profiles.shortDescription: ALEBRO Dosier- und Umwelttechnik e. K. is a German manufacturer of dosing systems and chemical preparation plants for dry, liquid and gaseous media. The company handles design, production, automation and commissioning in-house, and supplies solution preparation units, dosing stations, dry-material feeders, dilution units, precipitant stations and agitators. Its systems are used in municipal and industrial water and wastewater treatment.
fullDescription: The company page states: "Am 01.01.2007 wurde das Unternehmen von Dipl.-Ing. Alexander Brot nach 10 Jahren einschlägiger Berufserfahrung gegründet. Es übernimmt die komplette Konstruktion, Produktion, Automatisierung und Inbetriebnahme von Aufbereitungsanlagen und Dosiersystemen für trockene, flüssige und gasförmige Medien." ALEBRO Dosier- und Umwelttechnik e. K. is located at Heinkelstr. 20A, 76461 Muggensturm, Germany, and states that it works for customers in municipal and industrial water treatment.

The published product programme covers MixLine fully automatic preparation plants for polyelectrolyte and salt solutions from granulates and liquid concentrates; DS and DSM manual and fully automatic dosing systems for the precise dosing of chemical solutions, using diaphragm and progressive cavity pumps; precipitant stations for storing and dosing iron and aluminium salt solutions, used in wastewater plants for phosphate and sulphide precipitation; dry-material feeders in stainless steel or PP/PE with capacitive level sensors; compact post-dilution stations with integrated flow monitoring; and agitators in stainless steel or polypropylene, offered as rapid mixers and gear mixers for blending chemical solutions.

The site states that the company is certified to DIN EN ISO 9001:2008 and that its products — dosing systems, preparation plants, solution plants and related equipment — hold a GOST certificate for the Russian Federation. The website is also published in Russian alongside German.

profiles.officialName: Bertoli - brand of INTERPUMP GROUP S.p.A.
profiles.shortDescription: Bertoli is an Italian manufacturer of high-pressure homogenizers and piston pumps, operating as a brand of INTERPUMP GROUP S.p.A. Its range covers Evo Line and Star Line homogenizers, laboratory homogenizers, volumetric piston pumps, centrifugal and grinder pumps, and colloid mills. The equipment is supplied to the food, dairy, chemical, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, biotechnology and nanotechnology sectors.
fullDescription: The Who we Are page identifies Bertoli as a "Brand of INTERPUMP GROUP S.p.A." and states that the company has been "a technological leader in the sector of homogenizers and piston pumps" for 50 years. It positions itself as a partner that follows the customer through every phase, from defining the product to installation, start-up and support over the machine's life cycle.

The company's own timeline dates the start to 1974, when "Vittorio Bertoli opens its first factory in PARMA on Via Lasagna to devote itself to research and development of homogenizers". It records the first trade show in 1977, the S705 aseptic homogenizer in 1980, a move of the headquarters to Vicofertile (Parma) in 1991 and to the S. Polo di Torrile plant near Parma in 2007, acquisition by Rossi & Catelli in 1990, and entry into Interpump Group in 2015. Later entries list the Atomo 3.0 laboratory homogenizer and the Quark series in 2016, HA34 for ultra-high-pressure homogenization and nano-dispersions in 2018, the Raffaello EVO series in 2019, the colloid mill in 2020, the PS34 self-priming pump in 2022, the three-piston HA36 rated up to 250 kW in 2023, and a patented UP-valve rated to 3,800 bar in 2024.

Published products are homogenizers in the Evo Line and Star Line ranges, laboratory homogenizers, volumetric piston pumps, centrifugal and grinder pumps, and colloid mills. The sectors named on the site are food, dairy, chemical, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, biotechnology and nanotechnology. Contact for the brand is given as info@bertoli-homogenizers.com, with the site carrying the Interpump Group copyright.

profiles.shortDescription: Fabryka Silników Elektrycznych BESEL S.A. is a Polish electric motor manufacturer based in Brzeg. It primarily offers squirrel cage induction motors in the range from 0.04 kW to 3.0 kW, listed on its site as IE3, IE2, IE1, multi-speed and single-phase versions. The motors are applied in machine tools, air conditioners, fans, pumps and woodworking machines.
fullDescription: Fabryka Silników Elektrycznych BESEL S.A. manufactures low-power electric motors at Elektryczna 8 in Brzeg, Poland. According to the company, BESEL SA primarily offers squirrel cage induction motors within the range from 0.04 kW to 3.0 kW, and its own Offer section groups the range into IE3, IE2 and IE1 efficiency classes together with multi-speed and single-phase machines. The company states that its products can be used in many branches of industry, naming machine tools, air conditioners, fans, pumps and woodworking machines.

The company describes a history that began in a small workshop employing 20 persons and writes that for 70 years its employees have looked for the best methods of driving machines and equipment. Besel SA is today a joint stock company and states that it employs 450 people. BESEL SA has belonged to Cantoni Group, described on the site as a leader in electric motor production in Poland, since 1998.

On quality and markets, the company states that all its products are in accordance with European Union directives and carry the CE mark, and that DQS Deutsche Gesellschaft zur Zertifizierung, a member of the International Certification Network EQNet, issued its certificate for Besel for the first time in 1995. It also states that for 25 years a substantial part of its production has been exported to European Union markets as well as to Asia, Australia, Africa, and South and North America. The site publishes catalogues, documents, certificates and drawings for download, and technical and commercial specialists are offered as the contact route for enquiries.

profiles.shortDescription: B.L. Mediterraneo S.r.l., which trades as BL, is an Italian manufacturer of automatic packaging machinery based in Minerbio near Bologna. Since 1980 it has produced Form, Fill and Seal baggers, open-mouth and valve bagging machines, big bag filling machines, weighing scales, palletizers and end-of-line equipment. Its systems bag solid materials, powders and liquids into industrial bags, including ATEX applications.
fullDescription: BL manufactures automatic packaging machines that bag all types of products, and describes itself as a leader in the Form, Fill and Seal sector. Its published product tree covers weighing scales for bags and for big bags, octabins and containers; the FFS bagging machines COMPACTA, OPTIMA POWDER, APTA and AQUA-BAG; the automatic open-mouth bagger SELECTA and semi-automatic OMS; the FORTIS and FORTIS HS big bag and octabin filling machines; valve bagging machines and flat film vertical bagging machines; High Feed (HF), Low Feed (LF), robotic arm and robotic cartesian palletizers; and end-of-line wrapping and hooding machines, conveyors and accessories, up to turnkey solutions. The company lists the bulk materials it bags as petrochemicals, chemicals, fertilizers, building materials, wooden pellet, salt, pet food, alimentary products and liquids, with a dedicated ATEX section.

The company dates its founding to December 1980, in what its history page calls the heart of the Packaging Valley, where it introduced its first FFS machines and where the APTA series became one of the first FFS machines manufactured in Italy. The timeline it publishes continues with the tubular-film COMPACTA series in 1989, in-house designed weighing systems from 1994, the patented servo-driven net weighing CONCEPT scale in 1996, a palletizer division in 1997 and an engineering division in 1998. In 2006 CAM, described by BL as a historical worldwide leader in packaging systems, acquired the company, which the site says led to large scale, standardized industrial production; a new palletizer range followed in 2009, robot palletizers in 2011, open-mouth solutions in 2013, fully automatic big bag (FIBC) filling machines with bags on reel in 2018, and TÜV certification in 2020.

Operations are split between two sites the company publishes: the Bagging Division at Via Ronchi Inferiore 30/b in Minerbio (BO), of 2300 sqm, and the Palletizing Division at Via Don Milani 21 in Fontanellato, fraction Sanguinaro (PR), of 6082 sqm. The legal entity behind the brand is B.L. MEDITERRANEO S.R.L., with headquarters in Bologna, Galleria Cavour 4, VAT 02598631204, as stated in the site's own privacy disclosure. BL states that every machine is built to order and that it serves end users, OEM distributors and system integrators through a large network of distributors worldwide.

profiles.shortDescription: Bombas Bostak, S.L. is a Spanish manufacturer of coolant motor-pumps for machine tools and of electric motors, based in Azpeitia, Gipuzkoa. Its catalogue lists motor-pumps from 0.06 kW to 1.1 kW and cutting motors in the MCD and MTG ranges. The company states it also builds electric motors for the construction sector and has extended its products to the thermosolar sector.
fullDescription: Bombas Bostak presents itself as a manufacturer of coolant motor-pumps for machine tools and of electric motors, operating from Harzubia hiribidea 41 in Azpeitia (20730), Gipuzkoa, Spain. Its motor-pump catalogue lists the AC (0.06 and 0.09 kW), AV (0.09 kW, fixed), AX (0.06 and 0.09 kW), AZ (0.06 and 0.09 kW), BV (0.57 kW, fixed), BZ (0.57 kW), DC (0.06 kW), DV (0.24 kW, fixed), DZ (0.24 kW), EZ (0.57 kW), FZ (0.57 kW) and GZ (1.1 kW) models. Under electric motors the site lists the MCD 1, MCD 2, MCD 3 and MCD 4 models, the MTG motor and the BS-50M unit.

The company's own account of its history begins in 1960, when five partners already experienced in motor-pump manufacturing created a company under the name BOSTAK ELECTROMECANICA. It states that BOSTAK devoted itself exclusively to manufacturing these motor-pumps until around 1990, the year it began producing electric motors for the construction sector, which it continues to manufacture today. The present legal entity, BOMBAS BOSTAK S.L., was founded in 1996; since then, the company says, its technicians have continued to develop and diversify the sectors its products address, recently reaching the thermosolar sector.

Its published quality policy identifies BOMBAS BOSTAK, S.L. as dedicated to manufacturing electric cutting motors and electric cooling pumps for different sectors, and states that an integrated management system based on the UNE-EN ISO 9001:2015 standard has been implemented. The policy also commits the company to environmental legislation applicable to its activities, including reducing the consumption of the motors it manufactures and properly managing the waste generated. Customer orientation, staff involvement, willingness to innovate, process improvement and risk elimination are named as its strategic axes.

profiles.shortDescription: CONTROLLI is the Italian control valve and actuator brand now carried by iSMA CONTROLLI S.p.A., headquartered in Sant'Olcese near Genoa. Controlli S.p.A. is described on the company's own site as a leading Italian manufacturer of valves and actuators for residential and commercial HVAC applications, founded in 1936. Since the 2021 merger with the Polish building automation manufacturer Global Control 5 S.A., the range also covers controllers, HMI and wall panels for building management systems.
fullDescription: The company describes Controlli S.p.A. as a leading Italian manufacturer of valves and actuators for residential and commercial HVAC applications, headquartered in Sant'Olcese (Genoa). Its current solutions pages present a wide selection of control valves for room, zone, HVAC and industrial processes with a matched range of analog, network and smart actuators, alongside Control Point and Touch Point wall panels, PA-LED commercial HMI panels, the iSMA-D-PA7-B industrial HMI panel, the MAC36PRO Master Application Controller and the RAC18-IP Room Application Controller. The published technologies behind these products are the company's own nano EDGE ENGINE embedded software platform, the Niagara Framework and the Sedona Framework.

Controlli was founded in 1936 as the first company in Italy focusing on control equipment for the HVAC industry. Starting in the nineties it was part of various international groups, Invensys Plc. and Schneider Electric, acting as their European Centre of Excellence for the design and manufacture of field devices; in August 2011 B. Group S.p.A. and a group of managers acquired 100% of the company in a management buy-out, making Controlli a fully independent Italian company again. In May 2021 Controlli and the Polish company Global Control 5 S.A., which develops, designs and manufactures building automation solutions under the iSMA brand, formed a joint group called iSMA CONTROLLI S.p.A., jointly owned by the former Controlli and GC5 shareholders and holding 100% of both companies. The company states that Controlli reported near to Euro 12 million turnover in 2020 with 82 employees.

iSMA CONTROLLI states that it has over 85 years of experience in manufacturing control valves, actuators and intelligent building automation systems, and that product design and manufacturing take place in the European Union. Its operational centers are located in Genoa, Italy, and Gdansk, Poland, with a total area of more than 8,000 square meters housing production, R&D, a technical support center, sales and warehouse. The registered office is at Via Carlo Levi 52, 16010 Sant'Olcese (GE), Italy, with further sales offices listed in Milan, Rome and Padua as well as in Denmark, Sweden, Finland, Poland and the United States.

profiles.shortDescription: FACON SRL is an Italian manufacturer of over-moulded electrical connectors, wirings and cable assemblies. Its range covers connections for pumps and circulators, gas valves, actuators and 3-way valves, thermostats and sensors, pressure, flow and micro switches, solenoid valves and ignition components, plus a solar division for panel and large-plant connections. The company also develops customised connectors and specific wirings to customer requirements.
fullDescription: FACON SRL was founded in 1992 in Leno, in the province of Brescia, to develop electrical wirings for different fields, and later created its own range of over-moulded special electrical connections for pumps and circulators, valves, gas and sensors. The company states that it was one of the first Italian companies to believe and invest in overmoulding, and that it designed a full range of heating connectors on that basis. Its own summary of activity is "developing and trading electrical wirings for more than 20 years".

The catalogue is organised into connectors, wirings, assemblies and tailor-made solutions. Connector sections are grouped by the device being connected: pumps and circulators (PR201, PR202, PR200, PR660, PS10 and related adapters), gas valves (PE5X, PE151, PE6X, PE16X, PE7X, PE9X), actuators and 3-way valves (PR100–PR101, PR102, PR103), thermostats and sensors (PR43, PR41, PR90–PR91, PR50–PR52), pressure, flow and micro switches, solenoid valves (PQ SERIES, PE80–PE81) and ignition components (CA10–CA30, CA20–CA21, CA40–CA41–CA44).

A solar division was created in 2008 which, alongside the usual panel connectors, develops special solutions for large plant connections. The company describes continuous research on materials and process, which it says has led to halogen-free products, a wider range of operating temperatures and ongoing renewal of the production process. R&D and a technical department are presented as the route to customised solutions, special connectors and specific wirings.

profiles.shortDescription: Flour Valve (FLV) is an Italian industrial valve manufacturer based in Verderio Inferiore. It builds gate, ball, globe and check valves to API and BS standards, together with slab gate valves and FLV CONTROLS pneumatic actuators. The company supplies the oil, chemical, offshore, power generation and nuclear sectors, and also offers sub-assemblies, assemblies and device design and development.
fullDescription: Flour Valve presents itself on its homepage as a "BALL VALVES MANUFACTURER" with "HIGH QUALITY AND ITALIAN DESIGN". The site's own milestone timeline states that FLV was established in Italy in 2009, opened a branch in Zhejiang, China in 2013 and one in Mexico City in 2015, expanded its Chinese facility to 18,500 square metres in 2019, with a further expansion to 58,300 square metres planned for 2025. The company says it has been in business for over 30 years, providing engineering solutions to a range of industries.

The published product range is organised by standard: API 600 gate valves, API 6D ball valves, API 6D slab gate valves, BS 1873 globe valves, BS 1868 check valves and API 594 wafer check valves, alongside FLV CONTROLS pneumatic actuators. Beyond valves, the company states that it has extended its portfolio to include sub-assemblies, assemblies and device design and development, offering what it calls a complete turnkey service.

The industries named on the site are oil, chemical, offshore, power generation and nuclear power generation, together with mineral processing and steel manufacturing. Corporate identification is published in the site footer: Flour Valve, Via Fausto Coppi 5, 23879 Verderio Inferiore (LC), VAT number 02328840992, with the copyright line "© 2014-24 Flour Valve Italy". The company operates a second site, flv-valve.com, carrying the same content.

profiles.shortDescription: Friand Elektrotechniek B.V. is a Dutch manufacturer and assembler of power distribution boxes, extension cables and related accessories. Its range covers distribution and wall-mounted boxes, transformer boxes, cable reels and cable bridges, lighting, explosion-proof products, plug material, residual-current devices and circuit breakers, and components, including PowerLock and SnapLock. Products are used for temporary power at events, festivals, construction sites and in the maritime and agricultural sectors, as well as by professional PV installers.
fullDescription: Friand Elektrotechniek B.V. describes itself as the specialist in assembling power distribution boxes, extension cables and accessories, supplying custom-built solutions alongside a standard range. The company states that it guarantees quality through in-house fabrication and an extensive inspection and certification process, and points to its own articles on in-house product testing, its own rubber press shop, an automated milling robot and its ISO 9001 certification.

The company's history section states that Friand Elektrotechniek B.V. was founded in 1982 as a producer of rubber power distribution boxes. From 2006 the activities were extended and the company also became a supplier of extension cords and many types of cable, and it has since grown into a supplier of products for the professional PV installer. The business operates from Van Rensselaerweg 4A in Spankeren, the Netherlands.

The published catalogue is organised as verdeelkasten, verlengkabels, PowerLock en SnapLock, wandverdeelkasten, trafokasten, kabelhaspels, kabelbruggen, verlichting, explosieveilige producten, stekkermateriaal, aardlekschakelaren en automaten, and componenten. Applications listed on the site include trade fairs, construction sites, events and festivals, food trucks, catering, the maritime and agricultural sectors, temporary backstage and artist areas, pop-up shops and showrooms, ice rinks, test set-ups and prototypes, markets and fairgrounds, sporting events, and film sets and video productions.

profiles.shortDescription: GVR Pompe Srl is an Italian manufacturer of gear pumps for the Italian and international markets. Its self-priming volumetric gear pumps are built for transferring lubricating viscous liquids free of suspended solids or abrasive substances, and are offered in cast iron, bronze and AISI 316 stainless steel. The range covers monobloc, bell-coupling, bare-shaft and skid-mounted units, plus high-pressure and low-viscosity variants.
fullDescription: GVR Pompe Srl states that since 1956, the year in which Cavaliere of the Italian Republic Guglielmo Vagliani founded the company, it has specialised in the manufacturing of gear pumps intended for both the Italian and international market. The company describes a fully Italian production and says it designs, manufactures and customises a wide range of gear pumps according to customer requirements and needs. It operates from Via dell'Artigianato 19, Fraz. Fizzonasco, 20072 Pieve Emanuele (MI), Italy.

The catalogue is built around eight families: BMF–BCF monobloc gear pumps, BFC bell-coupling gear pumps, B gear pumps with bare shaft and feet mounting, BC gear pumps with heating chamber, MBM (B pumps on skid with motor), MBMC (BC pumps on skid with motor), APF high-pressure gear pumps and IF low-viscosity gear pumps. Each family is available in three different constructions: cast iron, bronze and AISI 316 stainless steel.

The pumps are described as self-priming volumetric gear pumps suitable for transferring lubricant viscous liquids without any suspended solids or abrasive substances, with the choice of construction material and of heated or high-pressure versions determining the fluids handled. Alongside the product catalogue the company publishes a downloads section and corporate contacts on its bilingual Italian and English site.

profiles.shortDescription: GWB is a German brand of heavy-duty industrial drive shafts, operated by Off-Highway Germany GmbH in Essen. Its cardan shafts come in closed bearing eye and split bearing eye designs and cover a torque range from 2,400 Nm to 16,300,000 Nm. The range also includes customised solutions, quick release couplings, companion flanges and journal cross assemblies, supplied to OEMs and aftermarket customers.
fullDescription: The company states that since 1946, GWB™ has led the market in heavy-duty, industrial drive shafts and genuine service parts for the scrap steel, construction, railway, marine and paper industries. It describes a full portfolio of driveshafts for mobile and industrial applications supplied to both OEMs and aftermarket customers, and says it has built a team of engineers and a global network of technology centres and manufacturing facilities. The legal entity behind the brand is published in the site's imprint block: Off-Highway Germany GmbH, registered office 2. Schnieringstr. 49, 45329 Essen, Germany, HRB 21816 at the Court of Registration of Essen, VAT ID DE456491780.

Two types of cardan shaft are offered. The closed bearing eye design is found predominantly in the mobile sector, is intended for general mechanical engineering applications and includes the GWB™ Series 687/688 and 587 shafts. The split bearing eye type is developed specifically for heavy and super-heavy-duty applications and includes the GWB™ Series 390/392/393 and 492/498 versions, which the company describes as compact, with maximum torque transmission capability, improved service life and easier assembly and maintenance. The overall range covers a torque range going from 2,400 Nm to 16,300,000 Nm.

Beyond complete shafts, the products section lists customised solutions, quick release couplings, companion flanges and journal cross assemblies. Engineering support is part of the offering: the company says its teams advise customers during the feasibility study for a project and that its engineers use special software to calculate the correct size of shaft and joint for each application. Certificates published on the site include ISO 9001, ISO 50001, ISO 14001 and DIN EN 15285-2 CL1.

profiles.shortDescription: Hagby Bil & Smide AB is a Swedish engineering workshop in Vassmolösa that manufactures the HBS-Rivaren bark scraper for sawmills. Alongside machine manufacturing it carries out welding, turning, milling, balancing, metallizing and machine repair, and runs a hardware store. The company states it has served agriculture and industry from Hagby since 1896.
fullDescription: Hagby Bil & Smide AB is based at Norra Hagby 141 in Vassmolösa, Sweden. The company states on its own site that it has been a partner to agriculture and industry in Hagby since 1896, that it began as a farm smithy, and that it has developed into a business with three branches: workshop (verkstad), hardware store (butik) and bark scrapers (barkrivare).

The manufacturing branch is built around the HBS-Rivaren, a bark and wood-waste scraper for sawmills. The site states the machine has been delivered for over thirty years and is exported to sawmills in eleven countries. Six model sizes are listed — 630, 840, 1050, 1260, 1260 Heavy and 1460 — covering throughputs from 25 to 125 m³/h with drive ratings from 30 to 160 kW, and the machines are offered in vertical-feed and horizontal-feed configurations.

The workshop branch covers machine manufacturing, renovation and repair. Listed capabilities include welding in stainless steel, aluminium, cast iron and steel including TIG; turning on two lathes taking workpieces up to 3000 mm long and 720 mm in diameter; milling on three machines of different sizes; a hydraulic press rated at 1000 kN; gas cutting up to 70 mm; mobile balancing of fans and rotors; metallizing of worn shafts and bearing seats; and painting of machines and chassis. Smithing work such as hinges and fireplace hood posts, and ornamental metalwork to customer drawings, is also offered, while the hardware store branch sells tools and materials.

profiles.shortDescription: IBK Engineering GmbH is a German family-run engineering company in Wuppertal working in sheet metal forming. It designs and builds punching and forming tools, thermoforming tools, devices, special machines and automated system solutions, and also produces spare parts and 3D printed parts. Its work is directed at industrial customers in metal forming and stamping technology.
fullDescription: IBK Engineering GmbH is registered at Bruch 13 a, 42279 Wuppertal, Germany, with offices and operations also at Hügelstraße 38–40 a; the managing director is Benjamin Koch and the company is entered at Wuppertal Local Court under HRB 33187. On its company page it states that the family has been active in sheet metal forming and in product and process development for more than 80 years, with roots in classic tool and equipment manufacturing and special machine construction, and that this experience led to the focus of IBK Engineering GmbH.

The company presents itself as an engineering and consulting partner for metal forming and describes three areas of competence. Under product and process consulting it lists product and process development, CAE simulations and feasibility studies, tool design and method planning, technical and commercial evaluation, and the manufacture of 3D printed parts. Under toolmaking and equipment procurement it lists punching and forming tools, thermoforming tools, spare parts production, customer-specific devices and special machines, and automated system solutions.

A third area covers business consulting, including strategy development, digital transformation, value and efficiency improvement, damage and insurance appraisal, expert assessments, crisis management and venture engineering. The site emphasises flexibility, short response times and support across all project phases without long-term project commitments, and addresses itself to large industrial customers in product and process management and supply chain optimisation.

profiles.shortDescription: Kiheung Machinery is a South Korean machine tool builder in Daejeon that has produced milling machines and universal heads since its establishment in 1968. Its range covers table type and bed type milling machines and milling centers, bed type milling centers with rotary tables, column travel milling and boring centers, double column machining centers and universal machining centers. Machines are offered in both box way and LM guide configurations for heavy machining of medium to large workpieces.
fullDescription: Kiheung Machinery is a machine tool manufacturer located at 11, Munpyeongseo-ro 17beon-gil, Daedeok-gu, Daejeon, South Korea. The company states that it has led the development of the Korean machinery industry since its establishment in 1968, that it has established a unique position in business fields such as milling machines and universal heads, and that it has developed universal heads since 1968. It presents itself as a machine brand with a history of over 50 years and says it has grown into a global company by focusing on expanding its global business network.

The product programme is organised by machine architecture. Table type milling machines are offered as the KMB-U5/U6 and KMB-U7/U9 box way models, with the three-axis CNC versions COMBi-U50N/U60N and COMBi-U80N/U100N. Bed type milling centers include U1050N, U1250N and U1350/U1500 on box ways and U1000LT/U1200LT/U1350LT on LM guides, with rotary table variants RT1050N/RT1250N, RTW1350/1500 and RT1000LT/RT1200LT. Column travel machines comprise TRAX, HiTRAX-U, HiTRAX-H, the milling and boring model WiNGTRAX and the fixed table RiGiTRAX. Double column machining centers are sold as MiMAX-W and MiMAX-V/-U, universal machining centers as UM 800/1050 and UM 1400/1700, and bed type T-milling and boring machines as TM1400/TRT1400 and UBM130.

The company describes individual models by their intended duty. The U1250 is designed for heavy machining of medium sized parts and can support a workpiece up to 16,000 kg, with 42 kW milling power and 1,636 Nm of torque. The RT1050N is based on the U1000 specification and uses a rotary table sourced from FIBRO in Germany or OMR in Italy for added precision and rigidity. RiGiTRAX is designed for heavy duty machining with a moving column travelling longitudinally for shuttle operation, MiMAX-W is a bridge type cross rail elevating double column machining center for big and long parts with a wide choice of head attachments, and COMBi-T controls three axes simultaneously for heavy machining of medium to large parts with 22 kW milling power. Kiheung also handles sales, after-service parts enquiries and overseas dealer enquiries from its Daejeon site.
productFamilies: BED TYPE MILLING CENTER with Rotary Table

profiles.shortDescription: Lamcotec, legally Laminating Coating Technologies, Inc., develops and manufactures polyurethane-coated and laminated fabrics. The materials are used primarily in the aerospace industry and in the healthcare and medical industry. The company has its head office and production facility in Monson, Massachusetts, and has been part of Trelleborg since 2018.
fullDescription: Laminating Coating Technologies, Inc., trading as Lamcotec, develops and manufactures polyurethane-coated and laminated fabrics primarily used in the aerospace industry and in the healthcare and medical industry. Its head office and production facility are in Monson, Massachusetts, United States. Before the acquisition it was a privately owned U.S. company, with sales of approximately SEK 185 M in 2017.

Trelleborg announced the acquisition of Lamcotec through its Trelleborg Coated Systems business area in 2018, consolidating the operation as of 1 July 2018. Trelleborg describes the transaction as a bolt-on acquisition that strengthens the group's position in engineered polyurethane-coated fabrics, and the same event is recorded in the Engineered Coated Fabrics history timeline as acquiring the U.S. based privately owned company Laminating Coating Technologies, Inc. (Lamcotec).

Within Trelleborg the Lamcotec operation sits in the Engineered Coated Fabrics business, which describes itself as a producer of specialty polymer-coated and calendared materials working with rubber, silicone and polyurethane coatings and with coating, lamination and hot melt technologies. That business addresses healthcare and medical devices, aerospace, outdoor recreation, pressure injury prevention and general industrial applications, and its material properties include extreme thermal management, flame resistance, water resistance, antibacterial protection, and UV and smoke toxicity protection.

profiles.shortDescription: LeROI Compressors of Sidney, Ohio manufactures compressed gas systems for the gas industry. It designs and builds single-stage and two-stage rotary screw gas compressors and reciprocating compressors, supplied as gas ends, modules or complete turnkey packages with PLCs, VFDs and enclosures. Applications include vapor recovery, gas lift, wellhead compression, gas gathering, landfill and biogas, and liquid tank transfer across oil and gas, industrial and process operations.
fullDescription: LeROI Compressors, located in Sidney, Ohio, USA, describes itself as one of the world's leading manufacturers of compressed gas systems. The company states that since the early 1900s it has designed and manufactured rotary screw and reciprocating compressors constructed to meet the demands of the gas industry, and that it has been supplying gas ends specifically designed for that industry for over 25 years. LeROI previously manufactured air compressors, but the brand has transitioned to focus exclusively on gas compression systems.

The product range is built around oil-flooded screw technology and reciprocating machines. Single-stage rotary screw gas compressors comprise the HG10 and HGF10 series including the non-geared HG10000 and HGF10000 models, the HG12 and HGF12 series rated to 125 BHP and 350 PSIG discharge, the HG17, HGF17, HGS17 and HGFS17 series for gas, oil, natural gas, industrial and process duties, the HG20 series to 300 BHP and 350 PSIG, the HG24 series for high gas volumes in field gathering and vapor recovery, and the LG30 and LGL30 series to 600 BHP and 200 PSIG. Two-stage machines are the HGT17 and HGT24 oil-flooded series covering 250 to 500 PSIG maximum and the LGT24 and LGT30 series, which offer the same capacity and power modulation features as the single-stage screws. Modules and packages are available for the rotary screw range and the LRG9-DP reciprocating compressor, either as turnkey packages or as partial modules for a packager to finish.

LeROI states that its compressors use very few internal moving parts and that none of its single- or two-stage rotary screw compressors contain valves, rings or packing that wear out over time, with design features listed as integral gearing, longer vibration life, variable Vi with integral porting, heavy-duty construction and versatility across gas ends, modules or skids. The company serves oil and gas, industrial and process sectors, including corrosive gas environments, and names renewable natural gas as a growing market, with biogas and biomethane compressors for livestock operations and landfills, landfill gas recovery, natural gas gathering systems, wellhead compression and vapor recovery units and towers. It also says it maintains a network offering 24-hour service and technical support.
productFamilies: Single Stage Rotary Screw Gas Compressors
Two Stage Rotary Screw Gas Compressors

profiles.shortDescription: MAX MÜLLER is a Swiss family-owned manufacturer of process observation equipment. It develops and manufactures process illumination and observation solutions, including light fittings, sight glasses with their accessories, and camera systems. Its customers are in the chemical, pharmaceutical and food industries as well as the environmental and utilities sectors.
fullDescription: MAX MÜLLER is a family-owned manufacturer of high-quality process observation equipment. The company develops and manufactures process illumination and observation solutions, namely light fittings, sight glasses including accessories such as wipers, and camera systems. It serves clients worldwide in the chemical, pharmaceutical and food industries as well as in the environmental and utilities sectors, and wherever safe and reliable observation equipment is needed.

The product range is split into three families. Light fittings and accessories comprise [Ex] and non-[Ex] light fittings and timers in accordance with ATEX and IECEx. Sight glasses and accessories are sold under the VETROLUX brand and are made in accordance with DIN 28120, DIN 28121 and DIN 11851, complemented by flow indicators and metal-fused sight glasses. Camera systems cover [Ex] and non-[Ex] cameras certified to ATEX, IECEx, INMETRO and EAC-Ex among others. Alongside the catalogue products the company offers industry-specific solutions for biogas, sterile and clean room solutions under the STERI-LINE name, and customized items such as made-to-order glass plates, gaskets and sight glass flanges.

The company dates its heritage to 1936, when its story began in the garage of the founder's grandmother's home in Basel. Its headquarters are in Switzerland, with subsidiaries in Germany and the United Kingdom and a global network of resellers. The company states that its products are engineered and manufactured to the highest quality standards, and describes sustainable, responsible and respectful corporate governance as its corporate responsibility.

profiles.shortDescription: Michell Instruments designs and manufactures transmitters, instruments and system solutions for measuring dew-point, humidity and oxygen. The company is headquartered in Ely, United Kingdom, and states over 50 years of experience in moisture and humidity measurement. Its equipment is applied in compressed air, power generation, process, oil and gas and pharmaceutical applications.
fullDescription: Michell Instruments works in the field of moisture and humidity measurement solutions and is headquartered in Ely, United Kingdom. The company states that it has over 50 years' experience and that it designs and manufactures its own products rather than only distributing them.

Its range covers transmitters, instruments and system solutions capable of measuring dew-point, humidity and oxygen. According to the brand description, these products are used across a wide span of applications and industries including compressed air, power generation, process, oil and gas and pharmaceutical.

Michell Instruments is presented as one of the established brands in the DwyerOmega portfolio, which has been assembled under the statement "Part of DwyerOmega since November 2024" and which the owner describes as offering gas, oxygen and level sensors together with measurement instruments including probes, transmitters and analyzers for humidity, moisture, oxygen and trace impurities. Other brands listed alongside Michell include Fluid Components International, Rotronic AG, SensoScientific, Ntron, LDetek, SST, Analytical Industries, Dynament, Isensix and Sensore.

profiles.shortDescription: Midland Pump Manufacturing Company Ltd is a privately owned producer of gear pumps and specialised pump equipment. Its pumps are of the external fixed clearance gear pump type, lubricated by the pumped fluid, and the range covers 30 basic sizes in four groups with specific discharges from 0.07 mL to 285 mL per revolution. The company manufactures in Birmingham and also supplies motorised, portable and magnetically driven units together with parts, service and repair.
fullDescription: Midland Pump Manufacturing Company Ltd describes itself as a privately owned producer of gear pumps and specialised pump equipment. Midland pumps are of the external fixed clearance gear pump type, lubricated by the pumped fluid. The gear pump range includes 30 basic gear pump sizes in four groups together with an extensive range of optional features, giving specific discharges from 0.07 mL per revolution to 285 mL per revolution, which the company equates to roughly 285 litres per minute at 1000 rpm.

The four groups are published by flow capability: Gear Pump LFP, a compact modular unit for flows up to 5 l/min; Group 1 for low to mid-range requirements up to 40 l/min; Group 2 for mid-range requirements up to 100 l/min; and Group 3, with cast iron housings, for the highest flows up to 290 l/min. Beyond the base groups the company lists HPC pumps, vertically mounted for direct drive by IEC metric electric motors and suited to water-soluble oil and machine tool coolant applications; Portable Transfer Units mounted on a tubular steel carry frame with options for 110 or 240 V motors and one-way or reversible operation; Vertically Mounted pumps submerged in the pumped fluid and supported by a bell housing flanged to the top of the holding tank; Motorised Pumps in close-coupled or bed plate form complying with IEC, VDE and DIN standards; and Magnetic Drive pumps, in which internal magnets connected to the pump drive shaft sit inside a hermetically sealed canister and an outer magnet assembly induces rotation, eliminating the need for a traditional shaft sealing arrangement.

The company offers fully engineered solutions and packaged equipment comprising the pump, mounting, control equipment and hoses, with material options including stainless steels and engineering plastics and with flange, foot, base plate and vertical tank top mountings. It states that its products have been made in Birmingham for over 50 years and that full parts, service and repair facilities are provided to maximise the working lives of its pumps. The business operates from Seeleys Road, Greet, Birmingham, West Midlands B11 2LF, under company registration number 1103911.

profiles.shortDescription: Midland ACS is one of the product ranges of Midland Flow Ltd, a UK manufacturer of pneumatic and hydraulic instrumentation based in Wolverhampton. The range covers 316 stainless steel valves, aluminium and brass valve solutions and actuator control systems built for extreme conditions with NACE and PED compliance. Midland Flow also produces the Alcon solenoid valve range and the Midland Rail range for freight wagon applications.
fullDescription: Midland Flow Ltd describes itself as a leading UK manufacturer of pneumatic and hydraulic instrumentation, based in Wolverhampton and serving customers worldwide, with capabilities spanning pneumatic valves, hydraulic control equipment, solenoid valves and rail control systems. The company states more than 60 years of flow control experience and says its products are built and 100% tested in Wolverhampton. Within its published ranges, "Midland ACS supplies 316 stainless steel valves, aluminium and brass valve solutions, and actuator control systems, built for extreme conditions with NACE and PED compliance." The two sister ranges are Alcon, solenoid valves with ATEX, UL and CSA approvals, and Midland Rail, pneumatic manifold solutions and door systems developed with wagon manufacturers.

The product catalogue is organised into solenoid valves (Alcon and Midland direct-acting valves), pressure control comprising filters, pressure regulators and lubricators, flow control comprising flow regulators, needle valves and check valves, directional control based on Midland spool and poppet valves, rail door systems, ancillaries and OEM spares. Alongside the standard ranges the company designs customer-specific solutions where a standard component does not meet the technical requirement; engineered-to-order products such as modified valves, manifold assemblies and complete control systems are described as a core part of the business, often based on proven designs and frequently continuing as repeat production for many years.

Midland Flow addresses chemical, process and industrial applications with demanding material and pressure requirements, oil and gas actuator control and process systems, rail freight door systems and control cabinets, water and power infrastructure, and sustainable energy applications including hydrogen and other low-carbon technologies. The company reports that its acquisition by Dacke Industri from Rotork plc completed on 5 March 2026, after which the business was renamed Midland Flow Ltd and now forms part of the Air Technology Business Area within Dacke Industri's Air & Mechatronics division, continuing to support its established Midland ACS and Alcon product ranges. It is registered under company number 02819224 at Patrick Gregory Road, Wolverhampton, WV11 3DZ, England.

profiles.shortDescription: Milton Roy, founded in 1936, manufactures fluid metering, mixing and control equipment, including metering and process pumps, agitators and mixers, and specialised dosing and injection systems. Its equipment is used in water treatment and in industries such as oil and gas, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, irrigation, paper, food processing, cosmetics and nuclear power. The company is part of Ingersoll Rand.
fullDescription: Milton Roy states that it was founded in 1936 and is now one of the world leaders in fluid metering, mixing and control technologies. Its ranges of pumps, agitators and specialised systems are used in water treatment and many other industries, including oil and gas, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, agriculture, irrigation, paper, food processing, cosmetics and nuclear power. The company operates as part of Ingersoll Rand, alongside sister brands it lists as Albin Pump, ARO Pumps, Dosatron, Linc, Williams, LMI, Haskel, YZ Systems and Hartell.

The published catalogue is built around metering pumps in the mRoy, MacRoy / G, Centrac, Milroyal, Primeroy, Primeroyal, Proteus and Maxroy series, and process pumps in the Megaroyal and Poweroyal ranges. Mixing equipment covers top-entry mixers (Helisem Series, HM Series, Robin), side-entry mixers including SRMix and custom-engineered units, floating mixers under the Helifloat name, and axial, radial and special impellers. Milton Roy also supplies systems and skids such as chemical injection packages, DOSASKID pre-engineered chemical injection, the ODOROY odorization system, Polypack and the CDX compact dosing expert, together with streaming current detectors, pinch valves, back pressure and safety valves, calibration columns and pulsation dampeners.

On quality and manufacturing the company states: "It starts with manufacturing the most reliable equipment. Our facilities are ISO certificated and our pumps, mixers, systems, and accessories are produced to the highest standard and comply with international standards such as NACE, ISO, API, ATEX, CE, and others." It adds that its manufacturing facilities have been certified to standards including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO/TS 29001:2010 and OHSA 18001, and that its engineers, technicians and partners provide service and support throughout the pump's life cycle from design and manufacturing through to spare parts and service, backed by CARE maintenance plans and spare parts inventory programmes.

profiles.shortDescription: Molex, LLC is a United States manufacturer of electronic interconnect products, including connectors, cable assemblies and application tooling. Its corporate headquarters is at 2222 Wellington Ct, Lisle, Illinois. The company supplies automotive, telecommunications, mobile device, data centre, industrial and medtech customers.
fullDescription: Molex describes itself as a provider of interconnect solutions, stating that it has more than 80 years of experience delivering connectivity at scale and that its commitment to product quality and engineering spans industries from automotive to telecommunications, mobile devices, data center, industrial and medtech. The company's About page dates its founding to the 1930s. Its site footer identifies the legal entity as Molex, LLC and gives the corporate headquarters as 2222 Wellington Ct, Lisle, IL 60532, USA.

The product navigation on the company's own site is organised around interconnect categories including Board-to-Board, Wire-to-Board and Wire-to-Wire connectors, Cable Assemblies and Application Tooling. Named product systems presented on the site include the KickStart Connector System, an OCP-compliant boot drive connectivity solution with integrated power and signal circuits; the MX60 contactless connectivity series based on wireless chip-to-chip technology; Quad-Row Connectors for space-constrained devices such as smartphones, smartwatches, wearables and AR/VR products; and MX-DaSH Data Signal Hybrid connectors that combine power, signal and high-speed data for automotive applications.

Molex presents a family of companies alongside the core connector business: Phillips-Medisize for healthcare and life sciences solutions, ISI for advanced packaging and interconnect solutions for OEMs, AirBorn for rugged commercial air and space applications, Molex Connected Enterprise Solutions, BittWare for enterprise-class FPGA hardware, and mPACT2WO for industrial digital solutions. The site also states that the company invests 5% of annual sales into innovation and runs an Intelligent Digital Supply Chain (IDSC) initiative supporting its manufacturing network.

profiles.shortDescription: Morara is an Italian manufacturer of internal and external cylindrical grinding machines. Its machines are used to grind railway axles, transmissions, gears and shafts. The brand belongs to FFG Europe & Americas, which acquired it in 2017.
fullDescription: The FFG Europe & Americas brand page for Morara states that Morara has been active since 1934 as a manufacturer of internal and external cylindrical grinding machines, serving the railway, automotive and aviation sectors. The brand timeline on the page records that Luigi Morara founded the company in Bologna in 1919, that the first cylindrical grinding machines were developed in 1934, that operations were halted in 1944 following wartime destruction, that the business passed to the second generation of the family in 1952 and to third-generation management in 1971, and that FFG acquired Morara in 2017.

The machine range presented on the page comprises the Morara MH for external grinding of railway axle end sections; the Morara Easy Quick OD, a flexible external grinding machine; the Morara MT 2500 HD, a double wheel carriage machine for large workpieces up to 2,500 mm; the Morara MT ID for internal grinding with multi-spindle capability; the Morara Easy Quick ID for internal grinding of couplings and sleeves; and the Morara MT Multimatic, a universal multifunction machine covering both inner and outer diameters.

The page describes the machines as offering high precision and repeatability with good accessibility for setup and maintenance, and states that they use adaptive control with real-time adjustment of the machining cycle to workpiece quality requirements. Applications named include automotive, e-mobility, aerospace, agricultural machinery, commercial vehicles and rolling stock. The site footer gives the group contact as MAG IAS GmbH, 73054 Eislingen, Germany.

profiles.shortDescription: Morillon is a French manufacturer of unloading and extraction systems for bulk products stored in silos. Its mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems are designed and manufactured at its own factory in Beaupréau-en-Mauges. It serves the agri-food, cement, wood, chemical and recycling sectors.
fullDescription: Morillon describes itself as an international brand designing and manufacturing unloading systems for bulk products stored in silos, and states that its mechanical, hydraulic and electronic equipment is completely designed and manufactured by its own teams. The company's history page records that Théodore Morillon founded the business in 1865 at the age of 28 in Andrezé, initially to manufacture mechanisms for water mills, which at the time were made almost exclusively of wood. A later generation moved into agricultural mechanisation, and in 1928 the company was firmly oriented towards machinery. In 1968 Théodore Morillon IV relocated the company to its present-day location, and during the 1970s it focused on handling equipment. From the 1990s the fifth-generation management opened the company to international markets.

The organisation page states that all of Morillon's systems are manufactured, painted, assembled and inspected at its 4,000 m² factory in Beaupréau-en-Mauges, and that the company has mastered every step in the manufacturing process: machining, welding, sheet metal work and painting. Morillon describes itself as a family company with a staff of some 50 employees that exports to 80 countries, and says 60% of its suppliers are located within 30 kilometres of the company to ensure short supply times. It lists two subsidiaries: Morillon UK in Sudbury, Suffolk, United Kingdom, and Morillon do Brasil in Maringá-PR, Brazil. The legal notice gives the address as 48, rue des Mauges, Andrezé, 49600 Beaupréau-en-Mauges, with Laurent Morillon as Managing Director.

The product range published on the site comprises the Spirogyre, Hydraugyre, Hydracone and Hydrasweep unloading systems together with an Electrical Unloading System. The site states the systems offer versatility and adaptability for the management of a multitude of products stored in bulk, including abrasive, hot, corrosive and very wet materials, with ATEX-compliant versions for explosive atmospheres. Morillon names five business sectors — agri-food, cement plants, wood industries, chemicals, and recycling covering wastewater, sludge, waste and co-products — and lists handled materials including cereals, food manufacturing goods, raw materials, oil milling products, waste, fuel, pellets and biofuel.

profiles.shortDescription: Morse is a mechanical power transmission brand in the Regal Rexnord family of brands. It supplies chain drives, mechanical clutches, worm gearing and couplings. According to the brand page, Morse products are used in the power generation, material handling, pulp and paper and forestry industries.
fullDescription: Morse Drive Components is presented on Regal Rexnord's own brand pages as a power transmission brand within the Regal Rexnord family of brands. The brand page states that Morse products have been a key component in the power generation, material handling, pulp and paper and forestry industries, and that Morse chain drives, mechanical clutches, and worm gearing and couplings have served demanding applications for over 125 years.

The published product structure is organised into three groups. Couplings comprise families of non-lubricated elastomeric and chain couplings as well as lubricated chain couplings. Gearing covers worm gear reducer solutions. Mechanical power transmission covers performance chain, clutch and open gearing products. Named branded products include Moisture Guard corrosion resistant roller chain, the KK Series compact cam clutch with built-in bearing support, the M Series clutch with hardened precision formed and finished cams, MORFLEX, the NFS Series clutch available in 13 sizes, PoweRgear reducers with cast iron housings and precision gears, and Raider Plus worm gear reducers offered in four styles.

The brand's history page records that the Morse Manufacturing Company was established in 1892 and the Morse Chain Company was formally incorporated in 1898, with the silent power chain developed in 1901 and an automotive timing chain added in 1908. The company joined the newly formed Borg-Warner Corporation in 1929 and developed the roller chain in 1935; in 1964 Borg-Warner combined the Sealmaster bearing products business with Morse Chain Company, operating from Ithaca, New York. Morse Chain Company was acquired by Emerson Electric Company in 1983 and became part of Emerson Power Transmission Corporation in 1987, which Regal Rexnord (then Regal Beloit) acquired in 2015.

profiles.shortDescription: Motomeccanica S.r.l. is an Italian engineering company founded in 1957 that designs and manufactures custom gearboxes, speed increasers and gearmotors. Its units are built to customer specification for medium- and high-power industrial drives, with stated torques up to 1,000 kN·m and weights up to 30 tonnes. The company supplies the hydroelectric, plastics and rubber, steel, oil and gas and nuclear sectors.
fullDescription: Motomeccanica S.r.l., based at Via dell'Artigianato 3 in Povegliano Veronese near Verona, states that it has designed and manufactured gearboxes since 1957. Its company page describes a business built around fully customised special gearboxes built to meet the customer's requirements, engineered by a team of designers and engineers with stated design objectives of high efficiency, adaptability, reliability and long life.

The published range covers gearboxes with parallel and orthogonal axes, speed increasers and gearmotors, together with revamping services for existing units. The site states that the company builds drives handling torques up to 1,000 kN·m with unit weights up to 30 tonnes, which places the work in the medium- and high-power custom transmission segment rather than in catalogue series production.

Application sectors named by the company include hydroelectric power, where it cites Kaplan and Francis turbines, Archimedean screws and crossflow turbines; plastics and rubber, with drives for single- and twin-screw extruders, calenders and mixers; steel, with winders, shears and rolling mill equipment; oil and gas, with gearboxes for reciprocating pumps also available in ATEX 2014/34/EU certified versions; and the nuclear sector, with gearboxes designed for lifting applications. The company states certification to ISO 9001 and ATEX 2014/34/EU, with API 677 and CRT 60.C.011.01 available on request.

profiles.shortDescription: MTL is Eaton's Crouse-Hinds series brand for process safety, automation, test and measurement equipment. Its core range is intrinsic safety isolators and barriers that protect electrical signals in potentially flammable or other hazardous areas. The portfolio also covers fieldbus equipment, signal conditioning, HART multiplexers, gas analysers, surge protection, industrial networking and HMI hardware.
fullDescription: MTL products are published by Eaton as part of its Crouse-Hinds series portfolio for process safety, automation, test and measurement. Eaton states that the MTL isolator range protects electrical signals in potentially flammable or other hazardous areas such as those found in processing, chemical, petrochemical, offshore, marine and pharmaceutical applications, and that the isolators carry ATEX and IECEx, UL, FM and FMc and marine certifications so that live maintenance can be carried out in a safe working environment.

Three isolator ranges are described. The MTL4500 range of backplane-mounted intrinsic safety isolators is presented as an IS system interface for distributed control systems, emergency shutdown systems and fire and gas monitoring, with customised backplanes available without the need for IS certification. The MTL5500 range of DIN-rail mounted intrinsic safety isolators covers interface tasks for process instrumentation, from single instrument loops to fully equipped cabinets. The MTL7700 range of DIN-rail mounted safety barriers uses removable terminals that provide a loop disconnect and clamps onto standard T-section DIN-rail. Both isolator ranges are specified with a rapid install-and-release mechanism, single and multi-channel I/O modules, 3-port isolation with low power dissipation, Zone 0 Group I, IIC and IIIC outputs, Zone 2 mounting, T4 temperature classification and certification for -20 °C to +60 °C. Eaton states that its intrinsically safe isolators use an innovative One-Core technology.

Beyond isolators, the Crouse-Hinds series MTL category page lists fieldbus equipment, gas analysers, HART interfacing multiplexers, industrial ethernet, industrial PCs, thin clients and remote workstations, industrial security and wireless, overvoltage and surge protection devices, process alarm equipment, signal conditioning interfaces, CALM buoy and berthing automation systems, and the MTL SUM5 Smart Universal Marshalling solution, which Eaton describes as combining five marshalling functions in one modular design. Eaton states that the manufacturing locations for MTL products are registered to ISO 9001:2015, and that its facilities in Luton in the United Kingdom and Chennai in India are certified for the manufacture of intrinsically safe products through a QA Notification from Baseefa (2001) Ltd; Eaton and its Crouse-Hinds series MTL portfolio are also certified as a Functional Safety Management company under IEC 61508:2010.
productFamilies: Industrial PCs, Thin Clients and Remote Workstations

profiles.officialName: MULTIVAC Sepp Haggenmüller SE & Co. KG
profiles.shortDescription: MULTIVAC is a German manufacturer of machines and lines for the processing, slicing, labelling, inspection and packaging of sensitive products. Its portfolio spans thermoforming packaging machines, traysealers, chamber machines, flowpackers, slicers, labelling and marking systems, inspection equipment and automation. Customers are in the food, medical, pharmaceutical, pet food and industrial and consumer goods sectors.
fullDescription: MULTIVAC describes itself on its international site as a leading manufacturer of machines and lines designed and built for the processing, slicing, labelling, inspection and packaging of a comprehensive range of sensitive products, offered as integrated packaging and processing solutions. The company presents itself as a family business from the Allgäu region in southern Germany with an international sales and service organisation. Its legal notice identifies the operating entity as MULTIVAC Sepp Haggenmüller SE & Co. KG, Bahnhofstr. 4, 87787 Wolfertschwenden, registered in the commercial register of the Memmingen local court under HRA 8040.

The packaging portfolio published on the site includes thermoforming packaging machines in compact and high-output segments, traysealers, chamber machines, flowpackers, shrinking and drying units, and box and container loaders. Processing equipment covers slicing machines, portioning solutions and dough processing equipment. Labelling and marking is covered by conveyor belt labellers, label dispensers and printing and marking systems that can be integrated with the packaging machines.

Quality assurance and line integration form a further part of the range: automatic checkweighers, visual inspection systems, X-ray inspection systems and metal detectors, together with conveyor systems, robotics, belt loaders and pack stackers for automating complete lines. The site also lists digital offerings including Smart Services, Line Control and a Digital Product Passport.
