Application sectors named by MULTIVAC include food products such as fresh meat, poultry, cheese, produce, baked goods, ready meals, seafood and snacks, as well as medical and pharmaceutical products, pet food, and industrial and consumer goods.

profiles.shortDescription: Nalco Water, an Ecolab company, provides water and process management solutions for industrial plants. Its stated scope covers water resource management and treatment, process improvements and pollutant control, delivered through treatment chemistry together with feed, control and monitoring systems. It works with customers across a range of industries to reduce energy, water and other natural resource consumption while maintaining plant productivity.
fullDescription: Nalco Water is published by Ecolab as one of its businesses and is described as a global leader in water and process management solutions working with customers across a wide range of industries. Ecolab states that Nalco Water provides innovative solutions for water resource management and treatment, process improvements and pollutant control, and that it helps customers reduce energy, water and other natural resource consumption, enhance air quality, minimise environmental releases and improve productivity and end products.

The business unit's own history page dates the company to 1928, when National Aluminate Corporation was formed by the merger of Chicago Chemical Company and Aluminate Sales Corporation, two Chicago companies selling sodium aluminate for water treatment: Chicago Chemical sold mainly to municipalities and industrial plants for boiler feedwater treatment, while Aluminate Sales supplied railroads conditioning water for steam locomotives. In 1929 the company organised Visco Products Company in Texas to sell sodium aluminate as an additive for oil-well drilling mud, establishing its presence in the oil industry. The name changed to Nalco Chemical Company in 1959 as research moved from inorganic to organic chemistry and the company developed synthetic polymers for water treatment.

Ecolab records that a technical centre opened in Naperville, Illinois in 1979 with process simulation equipment allowing product performance to be tested under customer plant operating conditions, and that a further complex built alongside it in 1986 became the corporate headquarters. Named technologies on the site include the PORTA-FEED Advanced Chemical Handling System introduced in 1984 as a stainless steel alternative to drums, the ULTIMER polymer technology that received a U.S. Presidential Green Chemistry Challenge Award in 1999, and 3D TRASAR Technology, cited in a published customer case at the AES Andes Ventanas plant. The company was acquired by Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux in 1999, renamed Ondeo Nalco Company in 2001, returned to the New York Stock Exchange as Nalco Holding Company in 2004, and merged with Ecolab in 2011.

profiles.shortDescription: NARZĘDZIOWCY is a Polish manufacturer of pressure reducers, pressure and differential-pressure regulators, shut-off and three-way control valves, and boiler desludging and desalting valves. The company builds its equipment at its own plant in Przemyśl and also supplies special designs to customer requirements. Its regulators are offered for steam, water and aggressive media, including versions for use in potentially explosive atmospheres.
fullDescription: Zakład Produkcyjno-Usługowy „NARZĘDZIOWCY" Sp. z o.o. is based at ul. Obozowa 23 in 37-700 Przemyśl, Poland. The company states on its own site that it was created in 1992 on the basis of the tooling department (Wydział Narzędziowni) of Zakłady Automatyki „POLNA" S.A., initially as a producer of tooling and technical equipment, and later passed into private ownership. Alongside its own product programme it carries out technological apparatus and workshop-aid work.

The manufactured range is organised on the site into pressure reducers, cut-off and three-way regulators, relief (pressure) regulators, differential-pressure regulators, desludging valves, shut-off valves for railway applications, low-range 15…120 mbar pressure regulators, regulators for steam, regulators for aggressive media, and special designs. Individual types are published under their own designations, including the RCP-3, RCP-8, RCP-8M, RCW-2, RCW-2T, RCU-2 and RCU-3 pressure reducers, the RRC-1 to RRC-5.1 differential-pressure regulators, and the ODM-1 and ODM-2 desludging valves, which the site describes as intended for desludging and desalting steam boilers and waste-heat boilers.

The company publishes a certificates page covering an ISO 9001 quality management system certificate, approval under the EU Pressure Equipment Directive 97/23/WE issued by UDT-CERT, conformity with the ATEX directive 94/9/WE for equipment working in explosion-hazard zones, and a hygiene certificate from NIZP-PZH for water pressure reducers and regulators. The site also names foreign representatives for Russia and for the Czech Republic and Slovakia, and its footer carries the copyright line „Copyright © NARZĘDZIOWCY Sp. z o.o. 2026".

profiles.shortDescription: New York Blower manufactures industrial fans and blowers for air-movement duty in process and ventilation systems. Its catalogue and custom range covers centrifugal fans, inline and axial fans, FRP fans, plenums and fan arrays, plug and process-heat fans, roof ventilators, steam heating products and fan components. The company also provides fan repair, rebuild, balancing, field service and replacement parts, including for equipment made by other manufacturers.
fullDescription: The New York Blower Company operates from 7660 Quincy St., Willowbrook, Illinois, and states on its site that it has engineered air-movement solutions since its founding in 1889. It describes its own history as spanning over 136 years and reports six U.S. manufacturing facilities, a family of specialised subsidiaries, and more than 200 representatives across North America, Asia and Oceania.

The published product structure is divided into centrifugal fans (backward inclined, radial tip, forward curved, pressure blowers and radial wheels), custom fans (including centrifugal airfoil, centrifugal radial tip, inline axial and inline plug designs), FRP fans for corrosive gas streams, inline fans (duct, inline centrifugal, tubeaxial, propeller and vaneaxial), plenums and fan arrays, process heat and plug fans with air kits, roof ventilators in upblast, centrifugal and hooded configurations, steam heating products comprising unit heaters and Steelfin coils, and fan components such as OEM wheels and cones, accessories and replacement parts. The site states that catalogue products serve as a baseline offering and that each fan or blower can be modified to the application.

Applications listed by the company include ventilation and air quality, dust collection, mine and tunnel ventilation, fume and odour control, thermal and climate control, material and product handling, pneumatic conveying, and chemical and process treatment; served industries include cleanrooms, data centres, boilers, ovens and dryers, pollution control, water treatment, agriculture, wood products, paper and pulp, power generation, transportation, cement and lime, iron and steel, mining, glass, petrochemical, food and beverage, and pharmaceutical. Mechanical services cover aftermarket retrofit, preventative maintenance, repair and rebuild, dynamic balancing, field services, testing, engineering analysis and 3D scanning. The site presents New York Blower alongside the group companies KDS Windsor, AirEng and Aerotech, and Windsor Group.

profiles.shortDescription: NGR (Next Generation Recyclingmaschinen GmbH) manufactures machinery for plastics recycling. Its range covers recycling extrusion and granulation lines together with add-on systems for material feeding, melt degassing, filtration and pelletizing. The machines are offered for post-industrial recycling, post-consumer recycling and PET improvement.
fullDescription: Next Generation Recyclingmaschinen GmbH is registered at Gewerbepark 22, 4101 Feldkirchen, Austria, which the site identifies as its headquarters, production site and Customer Care Center Europe. The company's imprint states its business purpose as the manufacturing and distribution of recycling technology, names Bernhard Bohusch, Günther Klammer and Erich Fürst as managing directors, gives company register number 148795t at the Landesgericht Linz, and states that the company is 100% owned by Next Generation Holding GmbH.

The published machine programme comprises the E:GRAN, A:GRAN, S:GRAN, X:GRAN DCU, P:REACT, ECO-Twin 220, F:GRAN, C:GRAN and C:GRAN-Twin lines, supplemented by add-on technologies for feed-in, degassing, pelletizing, filtration, peripherals, test equipment and the NGR Connect system. The degassing options are described as single venting, double venting, high-performance vacuum and combined venting, addressing contamination and volatile substances in the melt flow to produce a homogeneous melt without entrapped gas. The company summarises its purpose on its own pages with the line that plastic waste is tomorrow's raw material.

Applications are grouped by the company into Post Industrial Recycling (PIR), Post Consumer Recycling (PCR) and PET Improvement. Alongside the Austrian headquarters, the locations page lists Next Generation Recycling Machines, Inc. in Atlanta, USA, Taicang Next Generation Recyclingmachines, Co., Ltd. in Taicang, China, NGR Malaysia Sdn Bhd in Kuala Lumpur, and a sales office in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Service offerings published include customer service, test centers in Europe and America, used machines, a download center and a 360° service programme.

profiles.shortDescription: NOMA-Getriebe GmbH designs, manufactures and services industrial gear units at its plant in Windhagen, Germany. The range covers spur, bevel, bevel-spur, shift and worm gear units as well as special-purpose designs, together with drive periphery such as torque arms and drive elements. The company also carries out maintenance and repair of industrial gearboxes, including units from other manufacturers.
fullDescription: NOMA-Getriebe GmbH is located at Im Nassen 1, 53578 Windhagen, Germany; the imprint names Thomas Hartges as managing director, gives Windhagen as the registered seat and registration HRB 12435 at the Amtsgericht Montabaur. The company page states that the business was founded in 1879 by the master electrician Theodor Schreiber and that around 30 employees work at the Windhagen site, with knowledge passed on across three generations of staff and an established, certified apprenticeship programme.

The company describes itself as a specialist for the design, manufacture, maintenance and repair of industrial gear units, offering complete design of spur gear units, bevel-spur gear units and special gear units of any construction, plus development and production of the immediate gear periphery such as torque arms and drive elements. It also builds gearboxes to external designs and dimensioning, and produces drive elements as contract manufacturing from customer drawings or supplied samples. On its own production depth the site states: „Der gesamte Produktionsprozess – vom Rohteil bis zum fertigen Endprodukt – findet bei NOMA im Hause statt."

Service, maintenance and repair of industrial gearboxes are offered worldwide and around the clock, with the company positioning itself for rapid elimination of unplanned production stoppages and as a contact for servicing gear units of other manufacturers. The site states that NOMA has developed, designed and manufactured special gear units for companies including Jahnel-Kestermann (JaKe), Ekato, SMS group and thyssenkrupp since the mid-1990s, with agitator gear units (Rührwerksgetriebe) among the designs it substantially further developed, and it names itself an expert for maintenance and overhaul of JaKe-brand gearboxes. Listed sectors include chemical reactor and agitator technology, power generation and wind energy, conveyor and belt systems, water and wastewater, metals and rolling mills, mining and minerals, rubber and plastics, cement, pulp and paper, cranes, marine, and the food and sugar industry.

formerNames: norelem Normelemente Bau- und Vertrieb GmbH
profiles.shortDescription: norelem supplies standard parts and operating components for machine and plant construction. Its catalogue range covers positioning and assembly elements, components for machines and plants, measuring and testing components, clamping technology, electromechanics, and material handling and transport technology. Products are published in the company's THE BIG GREEN BOOK catalogue and supported by a CAD database and an online shop.
fullDescription: norelem Normelemente GmbH & Co. KG is registered at Volmarstraße 1, 71706 Markgröningen, Germany, entered at the register court in Stuttgart under HRA 202135, with norelem Normelemente Verwaltungs-GmbH as general partner and Marcus Schneck as its managing director. The company page states that norelem Normelemente Bau- und Vertrieb GmbH was founded in Stuttgart in 1958 and that the business has grown steadily since relocating to Markgröningen; the history page records the founding of the predecessor company PMP, Petite Mécanique de Précision, in France in 1943, the move from Stuttgart to Markgröningen in 1962, the works at Sainte-Savine in France in 1972, a new logistics centre in 2002, offices with a production workshop at Fontaine-les-Grès in 2006, and a modern office building in Markgröningen in 2015.

The published product overview is organised into positioning (flexible standard component system), assembling (assembly system), moving (systems and components for machine and plant construction), measuring (measuring and testing components), clamping (clamping technology), controlling (electromechanics) and transporting (material handling and transport technology), with a separate norelem inch programme of inch parts. The company states that its portfolio comprises 70,000 standard parts and that these are presented to designers and technicians through the order catalogue THE BIG GREEN BOOK.

Alongside the catalogue, norelem publishes a complete CAD database with files in various formats, an online shop with quick-order entry and availability checking, and states 98% of products available ex stock. The site describes the company as internationally oriented with a total of eleven sites worldwide, and records the founding of branches in Switzerland, Great Britain, Sweden, Spain, Mexico, China, Poland and Austria since 2012. It also states that training courses and workshops are run from the Markgröningen headquarters and via the international branches.

profiles.shortDescription: Norriseal-Wellmark is the valve and flow control brand of ChampionX, supplying valves and control equipment for high service industries and critical applications. Its published range covers control valves, back pressure valves, check valves, butterfly valves, relief valves, regulators, liquid level controllers, level control switches, and valve positioners with accessories. The brand states it has in-house engineering and technical support teams for sizing and application specification.
fullDescription: Norriseal-Wellmark is presented on ChampionX's own site as one of its brands and describes itself as a leading supplier of valve and control solutions for more than six decades. The brand states that it offers valves and control solutions used across a variety of high service industries and critical applications across the globe, and that its team of experts assists with flow control designs and application specifications.

The published product structure covers control valves, electric valve solutions, back pressure valves, check valves, butterfly valves and Series 2G Diaphragm Actuators; relief valves including the W9500 3" threaded, W2600 1" and 2" threaded, and W1392V vapor relief models; regulators including the 2001PR "Top Gun", 2002PR "Mighty Gun", W1301 "Mega Gun II" and W67 "Mini Gun II"; liquid level controllers in the Series 1001/1001A/1001XL, Series 1006 horizontal and vertical chambers, Series EVS, Series 6900 cantilever and Series 2001NB high pressure no-bleed lines; pneumatic and electric level control switches such as the Series 683, 686, 685E, 685I, 685S, 790, 1005E, 1005P1, 1100A, 1800, 7400 Snaptrol, 9321/9321E and W1200 DVO; and positioners and accessories including the Series 4900 pneumatic pressure controller, Series 8760P and 8760E valve controllers, the PS2 SmartPredictor positioner, the No-Bleed Pilot Valve MIZER, W20 sight glass, W30 gauge valves, in-line check valve, Series 1200A magnetic gauges and LevelGlas.

The site groups applications into upstream oil and gas (wellhead and separators, dehydrators and treaters, separation and storage level indication, valve position monitoring and automation, back pressure valves on separators), midstream oil and gas (compression and gas plants, pipeline and transmission, gas compression, recycle valves on compressors, dump valves on scrubbers), marine (shipbuilding and propulsion, engine cooling systems, cooling piping for steam, lubricant and oil), and industrial segments covering process equipment, refrigeration and construction. Support offerings listed include a rep portal, technical support videos, sizing programs and technical literature.

profiles.shortDescription: NovAseptic is Merck's brand of aseptic fluid handling hardware for biopharmaceutical manufacturing. The range consists of mixers, valves and connectors for clean and sanitary processes in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. Published mixer variants are the GMP, USM, HS and HSI models.
fullDescription: NovAseptic hardware is published by Merck as a range of fluid handling components for clean, sanitary processes within its biopharmaceutical manufacturing and multi-use processing systems portfolio. The site describes the range as mixers, valves and connectors intended to improve the safety, quality, potency and purity of the product, and positions the components as carrying Merck's aseptic applications knowledge and support. The brand pages are published under Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany.

NovAseptic mixers are described as a complete solution for mixing throughout the process line, designed for a wide variety of mixing applications in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. Four mixer types are named: the GMP Mixer for general blending, temperature control, cell culture and other critical applications requiring very low shear; the USM Mixer for general mixing where low shear is not a requirement, including buffers, cleaning solutions, glucose and vaccine adjuvants in upstream and downstream applications; the HS Mixer for difficult applications such as powder and solids dissolution; and the HSI Mixer for high shear mixing without a tank.

NovAseptic valves are published for aseptic and rapid tank draining, demanding SIP applications, take-off loops for WFI and other critical process supply loops, and downstream purification operations such as TFF, chromatography and fill and finish, with stated features including low hold-up for full drainability, no dead legs, long diaphragm life, a wide range of configurations and materials, and USP VI testing. NovAseptic connectors are offered in tank connection and in-line models fitting ISO, ASTM, DIN and SMS tube standards, the in-line version being used with sensors, probes and sampling devices and available with the NovaSeptum sampling system.

profiles.shortDescription: Oberdorfer Pumps, an Ingersoll Rand company, manufactures gear pumps, centrifugal pumps, rubber impeller pumps, progressive cavity pumps and roller pumps. Its published pump families are Gear, Centrifugal, Flexible Impeller and Chemsteel pumps, offered in bronze, stainless steel, Hastelloy-C and non-metallic models. The company states it serves marine, industrial, agricultural and chemical processing markets and customises products for OEMs.
fullDescription: Oberdorfer Pumps describes itself as an Ingersoll Rand company that has been propelling the pumping industry forward since it manufactured its first bronze gear pump over 100 years ago. The company states that it manufactures gear pumps, centrifugal pumps, rubber impeller pumps, progressive cavity pumps and roller pumps, and that in addition to its standard pumps it can customise products to meet the specific needs of OEMs. It says its products are distributed through selected distributors worldwide.

The site sets out four pump families - Gear, Centrifugal, Flexible Impeller and CHEMSTEEL pumps - and lists Bronze Pumps and Chemsteel Pumps under the gear pump section. Gear pumps are published as available in bronze, stainless steel, Hastelloy-C and non-metallic models for harsh or high-viscosity fluids; centrifugal pumps are presented for water treatment, HVAC, agriculture and chemical processing; and flexible impeller pumps are offered for marine and industrial duties. A Quick-Pick Selection Guide with performance charts and model codes is published for pump selection.

The company states its industries span the marine, industrial, agricultural and chemical processing fields, and its application navigation additionally lists agriculture, general purpose, industrial, marine, oil and gas, and transportation. The published history records that the pump department of Oberdorfer Foundries was formed in 1890 when Moses L. Oberdorfer began manufacturing bronze pumps in a small factory on East Water Street in Syracuse, New York, with the pumps used to supply oil for lubrication of engine cylinder walls in the early automobile, aircraft and motorboat industries.

profiles.shortDescription: Officine Meccaniche Gallaratesi S.p.A. manufactures positive displacement pumps, covering API 675 controlled-volume dosing pumps and API 674 reciprocating pumps. It also builds chemical injection packages to customer and industry specifications and hollow disc rotary pumps. Named pump series include ECODOX, IDRODOX, DOXA L/M, DOXE 2/3, DOXE 2FF/3FF and DOXE 4.
fullDescription: Officine Meccaniche Gallaratesi S.p.A. states on its own site that it has been manufacturing positive displacement pumps for more than 80 years, and gives its registered address as Via Cinque Giornate 5, 21013 Gallarate, Italy, with VAT and tax code 00816130157. The published history records that the company was established in 1907 by a group of Milanese entrepreneurs to repair textile looms, that its early activity centred on an engineering workshop with an annexed cast iron foundry, and that it later moved into machine building before settling on pumps.

The product catalogue is organised into API 675 positive displacement pumps for controlled volume duties, comprising the ECODOX, IDRODOX, DOXA L/M and DOXE 2/3 pumps together with special execution pumps, multi-head pumps, multi-series pump groups, molten sulphur pumps and premix pumps for the beverage industry; API 674 positive displacement reciprocating pumps in the DOXE 2FF/3FF and DOXE 4 ranges; chemical injection packages; hollow disc rotary pumps; and spare parts and service. The company states that its first patent for a hollow disc rotary pump was registered in 1918 and that the patented principle is still used in a series of pumps in production.

The history page records that dosing pumps were added to the range around 1945-50, that plunger dosing pumps advanced during the 1960s while rotary pump applications extended to tar, heavy oils, paint and soap, that a new series of double diaphragm dosing pumps was introduced in the 1970s, and that in the same decade the company began designing and building package dosing systems to customer specifications and the main governing standards for the oil and gas, chemical and petrochemical markets. The company reports that it adopted its first complete quality system in 1992 and was certified to ISO 9001 in spring 1996; its Quality page lists an integrated quality system covering ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, API QMS Registration and API Spec. Q1.
productFamilies: API 675 Positive Displacement Pumps - Controlled Volume

profiles.shortDescription: OMI is an Italian manufacturer of compressed air treatment and industrial refrigeration equipment, operating since 1990. Its range covers refrigeration and adsorption air dryers, filters, aftercoolers, condensate separators and drains, water-oil separators, industrial liquid chillers and liquid coolers, together with compressed air piping systems. Products reach end users through a network of distributors, dealers and authorised service centres.
fullDescription: OMI trades under the legal name Officine Meccaniche Industriali Srl and is based at Via dell'Artigianato 34 in Fogliano Redipuglia (GO), Italy. The company states that since 1990 it has been developing, manufacturing and distributing a complete range of products in the field of compressed air treatment and industrial refrigeration, with solutions designed by its own technicians. It describes serving the global market since its establishment and distributing its products in over 80 countries through distributors, dealers and authorized service centers.

The compressed air treatment side of the catalogue is built around dryers. Refrigeration air dryers are offered as the DD (Dolomite Dryers) series for flow rates up to 1300 m3/h, the ED (Easy Dry) series up to 24,000 m3/h, the energy saving ESD series using R513A refrigerant, the HTD high temperature series for inlet air up to 82 C, the HPD high pressure series for working pressures up to 45 bar, and the SFD sub-freezing series, which OMI describes as reaching a -20 C pressure dew point. Adsorption drying is covered by the KMD heatless series and the HL, HLA, HLA PRO and HBA series. Around the dryers the company supplies filters and filter accessories, aftercoolers, condensate separators, condensate drains and water-oil separators.

Industrial refrigeration is handled by the liquid chiller and liquid cooler lines: CHW water chillers in nine variants with cooling capacities up to 365 kW, CHG low temperature water chillers up to 126 kW aimed at chemical and food processing near or below 0 C, CHWL chillers for laser cutting machines, and CHO oil chillers in seven models up to 15 kW. A third division supplies compressed air piping systems comprising tubes, fittings and valves, fixing systems and installation equipment. OMI states that its dryers and chillers can be fitted with the Modbus RS485 protocol for remote management, and that its quality management system complies with ISO 9001:2015 integrated with ISO 14001 and OHSAS 18001. Applications named by the company include food and beverage, metalworking, industrial manufacturing, automotive production and oil and gas, plus ozone, hydrogen and nitrogen generation, laser cutting and welding, PET and plastic extrusion and blowing, and laboratory and CNC machine cooling.

profiles.shortDescription: Powernet Oy is a Finnish power electronics manufacturer that now trades as Inission Power Finland Oy. The business designs and produces electronic power supplies and power systems for critical equipment, including AC, DC and rail power systems, power supply modules, battery chargers and LED drivers. It serves industrial, utility and energy, rail, medical, defence and security, and LED lighting customers.
fullDescription: The Powernet name survives today inside the corporate identity of Inission Power. A notice published on the company's own site states that it concerns Inission Power Finland Oy (formerly Enedo Finland Oy and Powernet Oy) and Inission Power Oy (formerly Enedo Oyj, Efore Oyj and Powernet International Oy). The former powernet.fi domain no longer resolves, and the intermediate enedopower.com domain redirects to inissionpower.com, so inissionpower.com is the brand's current first-party site. The company describes itself as a European designer and producer of high quality electronic power supplies and systems for critical equipment even in the most demanding environments, active since 1975, and gives its address as Martinkyläntie 43, 01720 Vantaa, Finland. It is part of the Inission group.

The product portfolio is organised around power systems and their components. It covers AC, DC and rail power systems, power system components, AC/DC and medical grade power supplies, battery chargers, and LED drivers in constant current, constant voltage and programmable variants. The stated purpose of the range is to make electricity reliable, secure and efficient for equipment that cannot tolerate interruption.

The markets named by the company are industrial, utility and energy, rail, medical, defence and security, and LED lighting. Note that the live product and company pages describe this power-supply manufacturing business without using the Powernet name; the Powernet Oy and Powernet International Oy designations appear on the site only as former names of the current legal entities.

profiles.shortDescription: ProvibTech is a United States manufacturer of machinery vibration and condition monitoring equipment, now trading as PVTVM, Inc. from Stafford, Texas. Its range covers rack and distributed monitors, 4-20 mA vibration transmitters, proximity probe and piezoelectric sensor systems, mechanical and electronic vibration switches, and plant condition management software. The equipment is used to protect and monitor critical and balance-of-plant rotating machinery.
fullDescription: PVTVM, Inc. is the current name of the ProvibTech manufacturing business. The company's own support page publishes a notice migrating its staff email addresses from the provibtech.com domain to pvtvm.com, and its contact page gives the headquarters as PVTVM Inc, 10200 W. Airport Blvd., Suite 170, Stafford TX 77477, USA. The about page states that, based on its former company which had concentrated on machine protection and vibration monitoring, the newly re-organized PVTVM, Inc has continued to strengthen its position in the global market. The company lists Vibravista LLC as its master distributor for the Americas, PVTVM-EMEA in Wassertruedingen, Germany for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and offices in Qingdao and Beijing for China.

The company summarises its product range as machine condition monitoring software, machine protection systems, digital transmitter monitors, transmitters, sensors, vibration switches, hand held vibration meters, portable data collectors and accessories. Rack protection is provided by the PT2060 multi-channel rack monitor, offered in a standard 19 inch rack of up to 48 channels and a mini 12 inch rack. Distributed monitoring uses the DTM10 proximity transmitter monitor family for shaft vibration, thrust position and speed, the DTM20 seismic vibration transmitter monitor including the DTM20-A4 looseness monitor for reciprocating compressors and engines, and the DTM96 communication module that converts RS232 to RS485 and networks DTM modules over Modbus.

Transmitters include the loop powered TR4101, TR4102 and TR4105 and the three-wire TR3101, TR3102, TR5102 and TR1101 units, providing 4-20 mA outputs for radial shaft vibration, axial position, phase reference, speed and casing vibration. Sensors comprise the TM series proximity probe systems in 5, 8, 11 and 25 mm sizes, the TM0602 case expansion transducer, the TM0782A and TM0783A industrial piezoelectric accelerometers and the TM0793V velocity transducer, alongside the TM016 loop powered velocity and acceleration transmitter and TM900A DIN rail power converters. Vibration switches are offered as the mechanical PT500 and the programmable digital PT580 and VS102. Condition management is handled by the PCM360 and PCM370 plant condition management systems and the mobile PCM360-M. Applications named on the site are steam turbines, boiler feed pumps, cooling towers, hydro turbines and compressors.

profiles.shortDescription: PSP Pohony a.s. is a Czech manufacturer of industrial gearboxes, couplings, brakes and high-precision gears. It supplies both catalogue units and custom-engineered drive solutions, and states it has produced more than 500,000 gearboxes and offers over 50 clutch and brake variants. The company is based in Přerov and operates around 6,000 m² of production space.
fullDescription: PSP Pohony a.s. describes itself as a leading manufacturer of industrial gearboxes, couplings, brakes and high-precision gears. Its portfolio is organised into three areas: gearboxes, clutches and brakes, and components. The gearbox range covers helical types sold as ES, ETV, EJC, PREC, IMP, ALBOX ALFA, C3, TS and ASP, bevel-helical types EJE and NORA, and the bevel gearbox VVMK. The components area covers gears, shafts, rods and other parts for drive systems, produced either as standard items or to specific customer requirements.

In clutches and brakes the company lists electromagnetic brakes EBB, EBM and EBX, electromagnetic disc couplings EKA, ELS, ELK, EZF, EZA and EZB with the associated brake ELB, the mechanical disc coupling LSV and the flexible coupling VPS. The site ties these to concrete uses: EBB and EBM as functional and safety brakes in machine tools, winches, presses and conveyors; EBX in robotic and tilting arms and positioning and rotating devices; EKA in food-processing machines and equipment that runs long periods disengaged, such as refrigeration compressors and fans; LSV in gearboxes with frequent direction changes including marine and machine-tool gearboxes; and VPS in machines with heavy starting and reversing such as rolling mills and large compressors.

The company traces its origins to 1852, when the Heinik works was established in Přerov producing transmissions, friction clutches and grey cast-iron castings, and records its first patent, for Benn's flexible coupling, in 1899. It was reorganised as PSP Pohony a.s. in 1993. The site names intralogistics, engineering, healthcare, agriculture, ecology and automation as the sectors it designs for, covering warehouse and conveyor handling equipment, construction and mining machinery, medical and senior-care equipment, tractors, harvesters and food processing, renewable energy, wastewater treatment and recycling, and robotic and AGV/AMR platforms.

profiles.shortDescription: Ransburg is the electrostatic finishing brand of Binks, covering electrostatic powder and liquid coating equipment. The range includes manual and automatic applicators, rotary atomizers, powder booths, and automation and control systems for industrial finishing lines. Binks states that Ransburg represents its product and solutions portfolio for all electrostatic applications.
fullDescription: Binks presents Ransburg as one of its three core product pillars alongside DeVilbiss and Binks, following a 2024 rebranding under the Binks name. The site states that the Ransburg brand name is synonymous with state-of-the-art electrostatic technology and that this legacy brand represents the Binks product and solutions portfolio for all electrostatic applications. The powder coating offering is presented as an end-to-end system in which applicators, automation and controls, and powder booths are designed by the same manufacturer to work together.

The electrostatic powder line includes the Elite Series M5+ Manual Powder Gun, the Ransburg Elite Series M5+ Manual Powder Cart, the Elite Automatic Powder Gun and the RPA Powder Applicator. On the liquid side, Ransburg-branded applicators include the RansFlex Electrostatic Gun (RX/RFX), described as an air-atomizing electrostatic turbine-powered solvent manual gun, the RansFlex Electrostatic Gun RFXW, the RansFlex Indirect Manual Gun RFXI, the RansFlex Automatic Gun, the RansFlex AA85 Air Assisted Airless Applicator, the Ransburg No. 2 Gun, the Ransburg TurboDisk Atomizer for high-efficiency rotary atomization of waterborne and high-solids coatings, RansMACS and the Ransburg Color Select System.

Binks records the brand's origin in 1936, when Harold Ransburg developed the "No. 1 Process" by combining a radiological transformer with a DeVilbiss spray gun, pioneering electrostatic painting to reduce material waste, and states that in 1998 Binks, DeVilbiss and Ransburg came together. The powder coating pages name body shops, general industrial equipment, agriculture, construction and architecture, truck, bus and rail, and MDF kitchen manufacturing as the industries served. Binks lists its global headquarters in Minneapolis, Minnesota, with further production, lab and office facilities including Jackson (Tennessee), Bournemouth, Kierspe, Yokohama, Shanghai, Seoul, New Delhi, Riverwood and Estado de México.

profiles.shortDescription: RaVent s.r.o. is a Czech company focused on the engineering manufacture of industrial centrifugal fans. It produces medium- and high-pressure centrifugal fans with volume flow up to 25 m³/s and total pressure up to 12,000 Pa, together with ductwork accessories, silencers and acoustic enclosures. The company builds custom designs and states that it has its own development and design capacities.
fullDescription: RaVent describes itself as a Czech company focused on the engineering manufacture of industrial centrifugal fans, founded in 1994 in Milevsko, a town the company says has a long tradition in ventilation. The site records that the founders initially had their own know-how manufactured externally, that from 1996 fans were made in a leased workroom in Milevsko with the first skilled locksmiths employed, and that after a year production moved to the company's own premises, where it still operates following major reconstruction and progressive equipping with production technology.

The product programme centres on custom production of industrial centrifugal fans. The company lists four performance families: VV high-pressure fans, VVS high-pressure fans with specific blade geometry, VVU high-pressure fans with specific impeller geometry, and SV medium-pressure fans. Special designs are offered for transport applications, oilproof duty, explosive atmospheres (ATEX), increased ambient temperature, high air temperature and optimisation for altitude, with units supplied floor-mounted and coupling-driven or directly driven inside noise-reduction cabinets.

Alongside the fans, RaVent manufactures connection and acoustic accessories: transitions, elbows and duct sections, also in versions with 50 or 100 mm acoustic insulation; flexible connections (compensators) selected by surroundings and conveyed medium to prevent vibration transmission into ductwork; silencers dimensioned for optimum airflow velocity that the company states can reduce sound pressure at the outlet flange by up to 40 dB(A); acoustic covers for the electric motor and enclosures for whole fans; inlet boxes optimised to minimise suction losses; and custom supporting structures. The company states that its clientele consists of domestic and foreign customers, with part of the production exported largely to Germany, and that it has its own development and design capacity.

profiles.shortDescription: RHINEAIR is a line of aircraft fuel-tank ventilation and respiratory protection equipment that is now sold under the Aerial name by Aerial Machine & Tool Corp. The equipment ventilates aircraft fuel tanks and other confined maintenance spaces and supplies breathing air to the workers inside them. It is intended for those responsible for commercial or military aircraft and for other maintenance environments where HAZMAT fumes or particles are present.
fullDescription: The RHINEAIR brand is carried today by Aerial Machine & Tool Corp., whose site displays a standing banner stating "RhineAir is now Aerial." alongside the same notice for HazPro. Aerial describes itself as a maker of mission-critical survivability, safety and protection solutions, covering emergency breathing systems, respiratory equipment, ventilation equipment, fire suppression systems and protective cases. The company says it combines advanced materials, systems integration and precision manufacturing, and directs its work at the individual service member or first responder who is either in, or preparing to operate in, harm's way, serving the Department of War and first responder organisations.

The ventilation range that carried the RHINEAIR name is presented as portable air quality management equipment: the site describes aircraft fuel tank and HAZMAT environment ventilation systems together with respiratory protection equipment. The catalogue is built from pneumatic system kits and their components, offered in configurations sized for different aircraft and maintenance tasks, and is supported by accessories such as static conductive air ducting, a fuel tank underwing access adapter and a respirator mask.

Named units on the ventilation equipment page include the MAV 1 and the commercial MAV-1C, the NF55-1, NF70-1 and NF80-1 units, the CAN-50, CAN 45E, APV-2 and AF-178E, complete System #1, #2, #6 and #8 kits, and the 2SJJ0068-0003 breathing set for JSF aircraft. Accessories listed are the NFRA-8X and NFRA-4X static conductive air ducts, the AP-208 fuel tank underwing access adapter, the RC-80 respirator mask and the MAV 380 air duct and adapter kit. The site's footer gives the address 4298 JEB Stuart Highway (HWY 58), Meadows of Dan, VA 24120, and states that Aerial and the Aerial logo are registered trademarks of Aerial Machine & Tool Corp.

profiles.shortDescription: RIDGID is the tool brand of Ridge Tool, part of Emerson Professional Tools. The company states that it invented the modern pipe wrench in 1923 and that everything carrying the RIDGID name has since been designed and crafted by it. Its range covers pipe threading and fabrication, wrenches and tubing tools, pressing and expansion tools, drain cleaning machines and inspection, locating and test equipment for professional tradespeople.
fullDescription: Ridge Tool builds tools for the trades under the RIDGID name. Its About Us page states: "In 1923, we invented the modern pipe wrench and since then everything that carries the RIDGID name has been designed and crafted for strength, effectiveness and legacy." The company describes its mission as building for the world's expert tradespeople and says its tools operate in extremes of heat and cold, withstand dirt and mud and perform reliably day in and day out. The same page refers to "the talented, committed employees of Ridge Tool", and the site is operated within Emerson Professional Tools, with RIDGID patent lists provided by Emerson.

The product navigation on the company's own site sets out the range. Threading and pipe fabrication covers pipe beveling, threading, roll grooving, bending and hole cutting, pipe vises and stands, and pipe cutting and fabrication. Wrenches and tubing tools cover wrenches, bending and forming, tube repair and joining, and tube cutting and preparation. Pressing includes press tools, press jaws, rings and actuators, shearing attachments and manual press tools, while expansion tools cover PEX expanders and expander heads.

Drain cleaning is a further core line, spanning hand tools, sink, drum, sectional and rodder machines, water jetting machines, FlexShaft machines, cables and tools, and pipe patching. Diagnostics, inspection and locating covers hand-held and drain and sewer video inspection, plumbing and utility locating, and test and measurement. The site also lists utility and electricians' tools, including manual hydraulic crimp tools, the UC-60 utility crimp head, the 4P-6 4PIN dieless crimp head, the LR-60B latching round crimp head, the Swiv-L-Punch knockout punch head and the SC-60C scissor cutter head, plus general purpose and hand tools, wet/dry vacuums, power tools and welding equipment. Ridge Tool states that it runs its own training centres offering custom, hands-on training by expert instructors.

profiles.shortDescription: Roberts-Gordon is a manufacturer of gas-fired and electric infrared heating equipment, headquartered in Buffalo, New York. It makes low-intensity infrared tube heaters, high-intensity and electric infrared heaters, patio heaters, docked trailer heaters, air curtains and radiant heating controls. Its equipment heats industrial and commercial spaces such as distribution centres, manufacturing facilities and aircraft hangars.
fullDescription: Roberts-Gordon states on its About page that it is headquartered in Buffalo, New York, and that it invented gas-fired, low-intensity infrared heating in the early 1960s with the introduction of CORAYVAC burners-in-series, condensing systems. The company says it remains an industry-leading manufacturer of infrared tube heaters, offered under its CORAYVAC, VANTAGE, GORDONRAY and CARIBE brands, and emphasises high-quality materials and robust components chosen for durability and long-term performance.

The applications the company describes for its heaters run from distribution centres to manufacturing facilities to airplane hangars, along with smaller commercial and residential installations. Its published product structure groups the low-intensity tube heaters as CORAYVAC custom engineered infrared heating systems, GORDONRAY economical and versatile infrared tube heaters, the VANTAGE family of premium quality radiant heaters and CARIBE factory-assembled radiant heaters.

Beyond the tube heater lines, the products page lists high intensity infrared heaters, electric infrared heaters and electric unit heaters, docked trailer heaters, Roberts-Gordon air curtains, and radiant heating controls including the Roberts-Gordon Heating Controller and the CORAYVAC Heating Control. Infrared patio heating is covered by the UltraVibe two-stage low-intensity patio heater and the GordonGlo Elite high intensity patio heater. The company states that it is part of Madison Air, a decentralised group of brands formed through a series of acquisitions beginning in 2017.

profiles.shortDescription: Robertshaw is a manufacturer of controls and flow control components for appliance, HVAC and automotive original equipment manufacturers. Its range covers gas valves, pressure regulators, thermostats, ignition systems, thermocouples and burners, together with check, motorized, piloted and reversing valves, micropumps, defrost timers and temperature and pressure controls. The company traces its business to 1899 and operates global teams and manufacturing facilities.
fullDescription: Robertshaw dates its business to 1899, when, as its About page records, Frederick W. Robertshaw invented a thermostatic control for gas water heaters. The company today describes itself as the leading brand for safe, effective and efficient appliance controls, working in gas management, fluid management and specialty control solutions, and says that with strategically located global teams and manufacturing facilities customers get localised access. Its privacy policy identifies the operating entity as "Robertshaw Controls Company and its affiliates".

The company's OEM solutions catalogue covers gas valves, gas pressure regulators, gas thermostats and electronic thermostats, ignition systems and ignition controls, thermocouples, gas burners and top burners, energy regulators, manifolds and supply tubes. Fluid handling and control products include check valves, direct acting, motorized, piloted and reversing valves, customized valves, micropumps, lube oil controls, defrost timers, temperature controls and pressure controls. A separate parts range lists items such as air pressure switches, ball valves, brake actuators, drain pumps, defrost timers and electronic range controls.

Robertshaw sets out the industries it supplies on its own site: cooking, dishwashing, laundry, refrigeration, water heating and water purification appliances, heating and air conditioning, automotive applications including EV thermal systems, agriculture and specialty applications. The company also presents sibling brands within its portfolio, describing CastFutura as a portfolio of cooking and heating components, Paragon as setting standards for residential and commercial refrigeration, and Ranco as electronic and electromechanical controls.

profiles.shortDescription: Roesen GmbH Lubrication Systems manufactures oil lubrication pumps and box lubricators for industrial machinery. Its products feed oil to cylinders and stuffing boxes on piston compressors, piston pumps, rolling mills, steam engines, large engines and ship motors. The company also supplies spare parts and overhauls lubricators of its own and other makes in its workshop.
fullDescription: Roesen GmbH Lubrication Systems, based at Am Heuwege 10 in 27367 Horstedt OT Stapel, Germany, states on its English company page that it has produced proven and robust oil lubrication pumps for over 50 years. The company is registered as Roesen GmbH with the commercial register HRB 205861 at Amtsgericht Walsrode, and its managing director is named on the site as Jan-Friedrich Walther. The site also records the firm as a member of EFRC.

The core products are box lubricators built for "Pump-to-Point" lubrication. The site presents the model EZ box lubricator of the Grützner system, the high-pressure model HD rated up to 10,850 psi, and the model K/KUR series, alongside a constant level oiler and a spare parts range. The company states that Roesen oilers are mostly found in Pump-to-Point lubrication of piston compressors, which it describes as one of the most important elements of industrial plants.

The applications listed on the site are the cylinders and stuffing boxes of piston compressors and piston pumps, rolling mills, steam engines, large engines and ship motors, and refineries; engine makes named in that context include Sulzer, Jenbacher, MAN B&W and DEUTZ. In addition to new equipment the company runs a workshop for overhaul and repair, servicing lubricators of the Roesen, Grützner, IVO, Vögele, JM, Bosch, Manzel, Coulthard and Delimon types.

profiles.shortDescription: Rüeger is a Swiss manufacturer of temperature and pressure measurement instruments, including mechanical and electronic measuring devices and multi-point temperature sensors. Ashcroft announced its acquisition of Rüeger in 2019, and Rüeger® is now listed among Ashcroft's registered trademarks. Its instruments are used in refining, petrochemical and other process industry applications.
fullDescription: Ashcroft's newsroom announcement of the acquisition describes the company as follows: "Rüeger is a recognized leader in highly engineered temperature and pressure measurement products, with locations in Switzerland, Germany, China and Malaysia." The same announcement states that Rüeger's high reliability measurement solutions include a comprehensive array of mechanical and electronic measurement instruments, and that the company's innovation has spanned over 75 years.

Two capabilities are singled out in that announcement: multi-point temperature sensors for critical refining and petrochemical reactor applications, and proprietary technology for extremely high accuracy temperature sensing up to 1050 °C. Bernard Rüeger, Chairman, is quoted saying that the Rüeger brand will continue to grow successfully within Ashcroft thanks to new market synergies around the world.

The brand remains active on the owner's European site: Ashcroft Europe lists Rüeger® on its Brands & Trademarks page as a trademark registered outside the U.S., and publishes its Swiss contact under the address info@rueger.com. The temperature portfolio presented alongside it covers thermowells, indicating and electronic instruments, temperature switches, RTD and thermocouple probes and inserts, industrial temperature transmitters and multi-point temperature sensors, and Ashcroft Europe names oil and gas, chemical and petrochemical, energy, food and beverage, pharmaceutical and machine automation among the sectors it serves.

profiles.shortDescription: Sauermann Industrie SAS presents itself as a manufacturer of condensate pumps and measuring instruments. Its pump range covers condensate removal for air conditioning, refrigeration and heat pump installations, while its instrument range covers manifolds, probes and portable measuring instruments for HVACR work. The company is registered at Route de Férolles, Chevry-Cossigny, France.
fullDescription: Sauermann is presented on its own site under the heading "Manufacturer of Condensate Pumps and Measuring Instruments". The condensate removal pump range is organised into mini pumps, tank pumps, peristaltic pumps and supermarket cabinet pumps, together with accessories such as brackets, supports and cages and line set protection. Named products include the Delta Pack, whose elbow is described as having a tool-free manual opening for access to the pump, and the Omega Pack 2, presented as an all-in-one mini pump designed to be quicker to install and maintain. A range of peristaltic pumps is presented for installations where noise matters to the user.

The measuring instruments side of the catalogue covers manifolds and digital refrigerant gauges, wireless digital manifolds, probes and accessories, and portable instruments. The site presents a new generation of digital manifolds, the Si-RM350 and Si-RM450, together with their probes and connected accessories, and states that the range is aimed at HVACR work, including air conditioning, refrigeration and heat pump systems. Measuring instruments are also published under the group's KIMO Instruments brand, which the site directs to its own website at kimo-instruments.com.

The company publishes technical documents, brochures, software and applications, and videos in a resource centre, and lists an ISO 9001 certificate among its site documents. Regional versions of the site are provided for the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific and Oceania, and the contact page gives the corporate entity and registered address as Sauermann Industrie SAS, Route de Férolles, 77173 Chevry-Cossigny, France.

profiles.shortDescription: SAUNDERS is a diaphragm valve brand published by Crane ChemPharma & Energy, part of Crane Company. Its industrial range covers manual and linear actuated weir and straight-through diaphragm valves in lined and unlined constructions, with matching diaphragms, bonnets and actuators. A separate aseptic range supplies diaphragm valve flow solutions to the life science industries.
fullDescription: The SAUNDERS brand page states that P. K. Saunders invented the original diaphragm valve in 1928 and that the brand has since supplied fluid handling solutions to critical industries; the site also marks 90 years of diaphragm valve innovation over 1933-2023. The SAUNDERS Industrial Diaphragm Valve (IDV) range is described as a complete line of manual and linear actuated diaphragm valves in both weir and straight-through styles. The catalogue is organised into plastic lined valves, rubber lined valves, unlined valves, diaphragms, fire hydrant valves and manual bonnets, with SAUNDERS ES actuators offered for actuated service. The brand emphasises a comprehensive selection of polymers for corrosion and abrasion resistance in demanding applications.

Alongside the industrial line, Crane publishes the SAUNDERS HC4 range, described as aseptic diaphragm valve flow solutions for the life science industries, built around forged and machined block solutions combined with polymer expertise and automation technology. The HC4 catalogue is listed as HC4 sensors, HC4 actuators, diaphragms, bodies and manual bonnets, and the wider hygienic offering includes the SAUNDERS Bio Block, SAUNDERS Angle Seat Valves and SAUNDERS Hygienic Ball Valves. Applications named for these products centre on hygienic performance and regulatory compliance in critical processes.

The site lists the industries served by the SAUNDERS ranges as chemical, mining, water treatment, petrochemical, refining, oil and gas, power and biopharma, including active pharmaceutical ingredient manufacturing. SAUNDERS appears in Crane ChemPharma & Energy's own brand portfolio, and the pages carry the copyright of Crane Company, CRANE ChemPharma & Energy Corp. Customer service for Europe is given on the brand page as Crane Process Flow Technologies Ltd., Grange Road, Cwmbran, Gwent NP44 3XX, United Kingdom, while the division's executive offices are listed at The Woodlands, Texas, USA.

profiles.shortDescription: SCAN COIN is a cash handling equipment brand now published by PayComplete. Its hardware covers coin and banknote counting, sorting, recycling and deposit systems, smart safes and central cash processing equipment. The brand serves retail, banking, transport, cash centres and hospitality operators.
fullDescription: The SCAN COIN section of the PayComplete site states that for nearly 60 years SCAN COIN has been at the forefront of CashTech innovation, and that as part of the PayComplete Family it is now supported by the group's software and services. PayComplete's own history timeline dates the founding of SCAN COIN to 1966 and records its acquisition in 2015, describing the brand as bringing a long history of innovation in coin processing and management solutions used in cash centres.

The hardware presented under the brand is grouped into cash recycling solutions, smart deposit solutions, cash deposit solutions, coin solutions, bank note solutions and central cash processing. Within the wider device catalogue these correspond to coin counters and sorters, note counters and sorters, banknote validators and recyclers, cash and coin recyclers, smart safes, cash deposit systems, hoppers, self-service kiosks and cash centre systems such as cage and pallet loaders, checkweighers, coin lifts and coin wagons.

The equipment is offered together with PayComplete's software layer, described as unified SaaS tools and on-device applications for managing transactions, users, devices and data, and with professional, maintenance and support, merchant and platform services delivered by the group's engineering and consulting teams. The industries listed for the offering are retail, mass transit and parking, banking and financial services, cash centres and mints, hospitality and leisure, and OEMs and system builders.

profiles.shortDescription: SED Flow Control GmbH develops and manufactures valve technology in metal and plastic. Its range covers custom-made metal diaphragm valves for aseptic service, metal and plastic diaphragm and angle seat valves for industrial applications, and accessories including positioners, valve monitoring and control units, solenoid valves and flow meters. The company states its product portfolio spans on-off functions through to control applications, with a focus on pharmaceutical and biotechnology markets.
fullDescription: SED Flow Control GmbH describes itself on its own site as a leading company in the development, manufacture and sale of sophisticated valve technologies made of metal and plastic. Its head office is at Am Schafbaum 2, 74906 Bad Rappenau, in south-western Germany. According to the company's 'At a glance' page, SED was founded in 1984 and laid the foundations then for a product range that, in continually improved versions, still underpins the business today.

The company's own account of its development states that SED joined a group of companies in the mid-1990s, which allowed it to reorient its business and invest in new valves tailored to pharmaceutical and biotechnology applications, adapting the entire product range to those target markets and reorganising its sales structures. In 2010 SED moved to new facilities and reorganised its processes as part of the relocation. On 7 September 2017 SED became a subsidiary of SAMSON AKTIENGESELLSCHAFT, headquartered in Frankfurt am Main; the company states that this gave it access to a worldwide sales and service network and strengthened its presence in the life sciences sector.

SED states that it relies on 120 highly skilled employees to develop and manufacture custom-made metal diaphragm valves for aseptic service as well as metal and plastic diaphragm and angle seat valves for industrial applications, with the range also including positioners, valve monitoring and control units, solenoid valves and flow meters. Its online product selector lists diaphragm valves under the Steripur, KMA and KMD designations in pneumatic and manual DIN versions, filterable by valve style, usage, nominal size, nominal pressure, auxiliary energy, lining and temperature. A product configurator lets users build a product from a given specification and download the full product description or a CAD file in common formats, and the company operates a worldwide distribution network of agencies.

profiles.shortDescription: Sicme Motori, operated as the Orange1 Sicme brand, manufactures AC variable-speed and DC electric motors for industrial drive applications. The same business unit also produces permanent-magnet generators for wind and hydroelectric power. Its motors are offered for applications including wire drawing, metal and steel processing, machine tools, marine propulsion, ropeways and railway equipment.
fullDescription: Sicme Motori is presented on the Orange1 site as Orange1 Sicme, one of the group's brands. The brand page states that Orange1 Sicme produces high-quality AC variable-speed and DC direct-current electric motors and describes itself as one of the few references on the market offering technological and economic solutions for widely varied applications. The same page states that Sicme Orange1 also produces wind and hydroelectric generators. The footer identifies the operating entity as Orange1 Electric Motors SPA a socio unico, and the site gives the address Via Umbria 11, 20056 Grezzago, Milan, Italy.

The electric motors business unit lists its ranges by series. The MQ Series is described as a three-phase asynchronous squirrel-cage motor designed to achieve high performance and reduced dimensions in variable-speed applications. The RA Series covers DC motors. The SQ Series consists of permanent-magnet synchronous motors designed for industrial applications, while the HTQ Series covers permanent-magnet synchronous motors designed for integration into industrial machines. The NGBe Series covers brushless servomotors with permanent magnets for automation.

On the generator side, the business unit lists a permanent-magnet generator designed for hydroelectric applications and a permanent-magnet generator designed for wind applications, the latter offered with direct-drive capability. The applications the site associates with the Sicme motor range include wire drawing, metal and steel production, processing of steel and copper wire, sheet-metal working machines, machine tools, the naval sector and marine propulsion, ropeway and cableway transport, the railway sector, cables, converting and pumps.

profiles.shortDescription: SIDI MONDIAL S.r.l. is an Italian manufacturer of professional garment-finishing and laundry machinery. Its range covers ironing tables, shirt and garment form finishers, toppers and finishing cabinets, spotting tables and cabinets, presses for laundry and dry cleaning, steam generators, sanitising equipment, puff irons and irons with accessories. The company states it serves dry-cleaning, laundry, garment manufacturing and hotel businesses.
fullDescription: SIDI MONDIAL describes itself as an Italian company founded in the early 1960s that became internationally known for the production of professional finishing presses. The company states that innovative technologies allowed it to develop a wide range of self-sufficient presses with a built-in boiler, able to meet the requirements of large industrial laundries as well as small businesses, which supported the introduction of the company across world markets. Its registered address is Via G. Di Vittorio 6, 20065 Inzago (MI), Italy.

According to its own company page, ongoing research and development work on new finishing technologies has expanded the SIDI product range over time. The company states that it today offers a complete and wide range of finishing machines intended to satisfy the requirements of customers in dry cleaning, laundry, garment manufacturing and the hotel industry, and summarises its business philosophy as constant market analysis, high quality standards and pre- and post-sale customer service.

The published catalogue is organised into ironing tables — vacuum tables, rectangular boards, vacuum and blowing tables, vacuum-blowing and steaming tables and vacuum and steaming tables; shirt and garment formers, toppers and cabinets — shirt finishers, tensioning and universal form finishers, toppers and finishing cabinets; irons and accessories; spotting tables and spotting cabinets; presses for laundry and for dry cleaning, together with collar-and-cuff presses and trousers presses; steam generators for irons and electric steam generators; plus sanitising equipment and puff irons. Alongside the machines, SIDI MONDIAL publishes an extensive spare-parts catalogue covering boilers, arms and shapes, clothings and paddings, compressors, electric and electronic equipment, guns, heads and bucks, installation equipment, level controls, motors, pneumatic components, pumps, resistances and heating elements, solenoid valves, steam valves, topper forms, and vacuums and fans.

profiles.shortDescription: SINGFLO is the own brand of Xiamen Youme Electric Co., Ltd., a Chinese pump manufacturer established in 2010 that develops, produces and sells pumps. Its range covers diaphragm pumps, bilge pumps, bottled water dispenser pumps, oil gear pumps, macerator pumps, impeller pumps and solar pumps. The pumps are applied in RV and marine equipment, food and beverage dispensing, medical equipment, industrial and agricultural use, household appliances and solar water systems.
fullDescription: Xiamen Youme Electric Co., Ltd. was established in 2010 and specialises in the development, production and selling of pumps. The company states that its main products focus on diaphragm pumps, bilge pumps, bottled water dispenser pumps, oil gear pumps, macerator pumps, impeller pumps and solar pumps. SINGFLO is described on the company's About Us page as Youme's own brand, which the company sells worldwide.

According to the company, its pumps have been widely used in RV and marine applications, food and beverage, medical equipment, industrial and agriculture, household appliances, solar water energy, environmental protection, measured analysis, and printing and ink-jet equipment. The product site is organised around these uses, with sections for Marine & RV (bilge pumps, diaphragm pumps, washdown pump kits, oil pumps, water heater pumps, macerator pumps and in-line blowers), Leisure Marine, Beverage Dispensing and bottled water systems, Agricultural & Industrial Pumps, AdBlue pump systems, new energy and solar pumps, steering control systems, magnetic drive pumps, portable transfer pumps and misting systems.

The company states that its products hold ISO 9001, CE and RoHS certification and are sold in overseas markets including North America, Europe and Australia. Alongside sales of the SINGFLO brand, Youme offers OEM and ODM service, and states its aim of becoming a leading micro-pump and valve business. Support material published on the site includes a catalogue, a manual library, product videos, troubleshooting guidance and an FAQ section. The company address given on the site is 6F No.1 Tianan Industry Zone, No.143 Yuehua Road, Huli district, Xiamen, China.

profiles.shortDescription: SKAKO Vibration designs, develops and supplies vibratory equipment for handling bulk materials. Its range includes feeders, conveyors, grizzlies and screens, as well as densimetric tables, lift-tippers and washing drums. The equipment moves, separates and washes bulk materials for the recycling, mineral and fastener industries.
fullDescription: SKAKO Vibration states that it designs, develops and supplies vibratory equipment such as feeders, conveyors, grizzlies and screens, as well as densimetric tables, lift-tippers and washing drums, in order to move, separate and wash bulk materials. The company presents its equipment as engineered for material handling, control and separation in demanding industrial environments, and uses the tagline "For good vibrations".

The published product programme is grouped into conveyors (natural frequency, spiral and vibrating conveyors), screens (banana, compact, flip flow, heavy-duty circular motion, heavy-duty linear motion, medium-duty, probabilistic, shake-out and combi screens), feeders (furnace chargers and furnace feeders, grizzly feeders and scalpers, heavy-duty feeders, storage feeders and hoppers, spread feeders and vibrating feeders), industrial tippers and lifts (gear tipper, hydraulic tipper, lift tipper), grading, filling and packaging systems (size grading, box packaging and gabion filling systems), weighing and control systems, washers (logwasher, washing and dewatering screens, washing drums), vibration tables and accessories such as air cannons.

The company names the recycling, mineral and fastener industries as its markets, with mineral work covering mining, quarries, sand pits and the iron and steel sector, and fastener work linked to the automotive sector. SKAKO states that it brings its engineering and expertise from offices in Faaborg, Strasbourg and San Sebastián, and that it operates an expert centre in Spain specialised in equipment for the recycling industry. The contact pages list the group entities and their addresses, with SKAKO VIBRATION A/S at Bygmestervej 2, 5600 Faaborg, Denmark, alongside SKAKO VIBRATION SA in Strasbourg, SKAKO VIBRATION GmbH in Haltern am See, SKAKO VIBRATION Ltd in Tadcaster, and offices in Morocco and Spain.

profiles.shortDescription: SMW-AUTOBLOK manufactures workholding systems for turning, grinding and milling machine tools. The company states that it develops, manufactures and supports all of its own products, which are made in production facilities in Meckenbeuren, Germany and Caprie, Italy. Its catalogue covers turning and stationary chucks, grinding workholding, jaws, automation, live tooling and OCTG clamping.
fullDescription: SMW-AUTOBLOK manufactures workholding systems for turning, grinding and milling machine tools, and states that it develops, manufactures and supports all of its own products, setting standards for the industry worldwide. The company describes itself as a multinational group of companies and a technical and commercial leader in the field of workholding systems for machine tools, and as among the leading manufacturers worldwide of workholding for turning and grinding machine tools.

Production is carried out in-house: the site states that the range is manufactured using the latest generation machines in production facilities in Meckenbeuren, Germany and Caprie, Italy. The company attributes its position to decades of experience in workholding combined with continual technological innovation based on client feedback, and notes that its extensive range of standard catalogue products allows applications to be delivered quickly, supported by a global network of branches and agents.

The published catalogue is organised into Turning, Automation, Stationary, Grinding, Jaws, OCTG, Live Tooling and Tobler Turning sections, and the company names automotive, OCTG, industrial equipment, off-highway and aerospace as the industries it serves. On its history, the site states that SMW-AUTOBLOK started 75 years ago in Turin, Italy and 50 years ago in Meckenbeuren, Germany. The Italian legal entity given in the site footer is AUTOBLOK S.P.A., Via Duca d'Aosta 24, fraz. Novaretto, 10040 Caprie (TO), Italy.

profiles.shortDescription: Spandau Pumpen, founded in 1932, manufactures high-performance pumping systems, principally vertical centrifugal coolant pumps and hydrocyclones. Its pumps are used in machine tools, the printing and packaging industry, temperature control units and other industrial applications, including contaminated-water management and ATEX-certified applications. The brand has been part of EBARA since 2023 and is presented as Spandau Pumpen by EBARA.
fullDescription: Spandau Pumpen states that it was founded in 1932 and has built a reputation based on German engineering excellence. The brand supplies high-performance pumping systems used in machine tools, the printing and packaging industry, temperature control units and a wide range of other industrial applications, and it describes its products as offering long service life, energy efficiency and operational reliability, developed through streamlined processes and a highly specialised organisation.

The published product programme consists mainly of vertical centrifugal pumps, listed under the PAB, PMS, PRA, PRG, PRK, PS-PSL, PSR and PR4 designations, together with HDZ hydrocyclones. The company describes these as coolant pumps developed to let customers work more economically and efficiently, and states that its solutions are intended to optimise productivity and reduce operating costs in demanding environments, including contaminated-water management and ATEX-certified applications where safety and performance are critical.

The brand's ownership is stated directly on its own site: in 2023 EBARA acquired Spandau Pumpen, a step the company describes as part of its commitment to continuous improvement, and the site is now published under the name Spandau Pumpen by EBARA with the aim of combining Spandau's legacy of reliability with EBARA's technologies in tailored solutions. The site operator given in the footer is EBARA Pumps Europe S.p.A., Via Torri di Confine 2/1 int. C, 36053 Gambellara (Vicenza), Italy.

profiles.shortDescription: SPIROL manufactures engineered fasteners, shims, installation machines and parts feeding equipment. Its product lines include coiled and slotted spring pins, solid pins, alignment dowels and bushings, spacers, compression limiters, threaded inserts for plastics, railroad nuts, disc springs and precision shims. The company supplies OEMs and distributors and provides application engineering support for fastening, joining and assembly.
fullDescription: SPIROL International Corporation describes itself on its own site as "the leading global manufacturer of engineered fasteners, shims, installation machines, and parts feeding equipment producing over two billion components annually". The site states that SPIROL has been a partner of OEMs and distributors since 1948, that it offers 12 major product lines and around 30,000 standard items, and that Application Engineers are available worldwide, supported by manufacturing centers and global stocking facilities.

The product range covers coiled spring pins (standard, heavy and light duty, plus application-specific versions), slotted spring pins including SPIROL Standard and ISO 8752 types, solid pins such as straight/dowel, knurled, barbed and Press-N-Lok pins, alignment dowels and bushings, spacers, compression limiters in post-mold installed and molded-in versions, threaded inserts for plastics (press-in, self-tapping, heat/ultrasonic and molded-in), railroad nuts, disc springs to DIN EN 16983 (formerly DIN 2093) including stainless steel and pre-assembled stacks, and precision shims. SPIROL also builds fastener installation equipment for pins, threaded inserts and compression limiters, and vibratory feeder systems.

The company markets these products to aerospace and defense, agriculture and heavy equipment, alternative energy and green technology, automotive, plastic molding, cosmetic, durable consumer products, industrial and medical applications. It offers complimentary application engineering, described as a five-step process from defining objectives through engineering evaluation, technical and commercial proposal, delivery of a complete assembly solution including fixture design and machine certification, and production planning. The site lists quality certifications including IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, Ford Q1, AS 9100, Nadcap AC7108 and AC7116, and Caterpillar MQ11005 SQEP. The corporate address given by the company is SPIROL International Corporation, 30 Rock Avenue, Danielson, CT 06239-1434, United States, with a separate SPIROL Shim Division in Stow, Ohio.

profiles.shortDescription: Stedman Machine Company manufactures industrial size reduction and crushing equipment. Its product lines are horizontal and vertical shaft impact crushers, cage mills and pulverizers, hammer mill crushers, lump breakers and chain mills, together with wear parts, rebuild and installation services. The equipment is used in aggregates, minerals and mining, ceramic brick and clay, asphalt recycling, fertilizer, distilling, agriculture, biomass and recycling applications.
fullDescription: Stedman Machine Company is a manufacturer of size reduction and crushing equipment; its own site is titled "Industrial Crushing Equipment & Pulverizing Mill Manufacturer" and states that the company "has the engineering experience to design, manufacture, and install custom crushing" systems. The company's About Us page states that Stedman Machine Company was established in 1834 in southeastern Indiana by Nathan R. Stedman, beginning with castings and machinery for products such as cotton gins, farm equipment, machine tools, hay presses, stoves and sawmills, and that it has since been a manufacturer of size reduction and crushing equipment from the first cage mill through later impactor developments. The same page describes Stedman today as an affiliate of Eagle Crusher Company that designs, manufactures and sells a complete line of size-reduction equipment, and notes that in 2002 Stedman opened an affiliate company, Innovative Processing Solutions, to design, build and install bulk handling and crushing systems used with Stedman equipment.

The equipment range comprises impact crushers (Mega Slam HSI, Grand Slam HSI, V-Slam Impactor VSI and the Grand Slam Asphalt Recycler), cage mills and pulverizers (H-Series Impact Mill, Copper Line Cage Mill, F-Series, Y-Series and X-Series Cage Mills), hammer mill crushers (Full Circle Hammer Mill, Copper Line Hammer Mill, A&B Series Hammer Mill), lump breakers including the Aurora Lump Breaker and Chain Mill, plus used and refurbished crushers and custom reduction systems. Beyond individual machines the company provides dry bulk material systems engineering covering crushing, screening, structures, conveyors, chutes, hoppers, dust collection and storage, along with process and control system design and project management and installation.

Stedman states that its equipment is applied in rock and aggregates including limestone, minerals and mining, ceramic brick and clay, asphalt recycling, fertilizer, distilleries, food waste and animal feed, agriculture, herbs and spices, e-scrap recycling, and energy and biomass. The company operates a testing and toll processing facility where customer material is run on full-size equipment, and says it holds more than 10,000 test reports. After-sales support includes an inventory of impact crusher and cage mill wear and spare parts such as breaker bars, wear liners, bearings, electrical components and shafts, custom fabrication, inspection, rebuild and repair, maintenance and installation. The site gives the company address as 129 Franklin Street, Aurora, IN 47001.

profiles.shortDescription: Sterling Electric, Inc. produces AC induction electric motors, gearbox reducers and gearmotors for industrial use.
