Its motor range covers stainless steel, rolled steel washdown, painted rolled steel, cast iron ribbed frame and definite purpose designs, and its drive range covers helical bevel, in-line helical, right angle worm and smooth body reducers, ratio multipliers and helical inline gearmotors. The company publishes its own product catalogs and manuals for these lines.
fullDescription: Sterling Electric, Inc. is a manufacturer of industrial electric motors and power transmission products based in Indianapolis, Indiana. The company's About page states that it was founded in 1927 in Los Angeles, California, that it has also operated under the names Sterling Electric Motors and Sterling Power Systems, Inc., and that its headquarters are now in Indianapolis. It states its mission as providing quality industrial motors and related equipment with reliable delivery and service, and its motto on the homepage is "Sterling Electric, Inc Where Quality is in Control."

The motor range published on the site includes Xtreme Duty Stainless Steel motors (10 Hp and below), Standard Stainless Steel motors (30 Hp and below), Rolled Steel White Washdown motors (10 Hp and below), Standard Rolled Steel Gray Painted motors (10 Hp and below), Cast Iron Ribbed Frame motors (15 Hp and above) and Definite Purpose motors. The About page describes stainless steel motors from 1/4 HP through 30 HP and stainless steel worm gear reducers with ratios from 5:1 through 3600:1. The gear reducer range covers helical bevel, smooth body, in-line helical and right angle worm units together with ratio multipliers, and the company also offers helical inline gearmotors.

Sterling Electric publishes its own technical literature for these products, including an Electrical Products catalog, Helical Gear Products and Worm Gear Products catalogs, a Stainless Drive Package catalog, Xtreme Encapsulated Motors, Symmetrical Tapered Bushing and Sanitary Worm Gear Reducer literature, a Definite Purpose Motors 2026 flyer, Universal Picker Motors literature and Backstop Kit installation instructions, alongside product manuals and a support section. The company's address on its own site is 5455 W. 84th Street, Indianapolis, Indiana 46268.

profiles.shortDescription: Sun Hydraulics designs and manufactures screw-in hydraulic cartridge valves, manifolds and electro-hydraulic products that control force, speed and motion in fluid power systems. Its cartridge range covers pressure control, flow control, load holding, directional, electro-proportional, solenoid operated and specialty functions. The products are sold globally, primarily through independent distributors, to manufacturers of mobile and industrial equipment and machinery.
fullDescription: Sun Hydraulics describes itself on its own About page as "a leading designer and manufacturer of high-performance screw-in hydraulic cartridge valves and manifolds that control force, speed and motion as integral components in fluid power systems". The same page states that the company has been in business since 1970 and was a public company from 1997, that Sun Hydraulics Corporation became Helios Technologies (NYSE: HLIO) in 2018, and that Sun Hydraulics LLC operates as a wholly owned company under that corporate name, selling its products globally and primarily through independent distributors to mobile and industrial equipment and machinery manufacturers. The parent company's operating companies page states that "Sun Hydraulics manufactures screw-in hydraulic cartridge valves, electro-hydraulics, manifolds, and integrated package solutions" used in the industrial and mobile hydraulics markets.

The product catalog is organized into cartridges, manifolds, electronics and accessories. Cartridge functions listed on the site include pressure control (relief, reducing, reducing/relieving and sequence), flow control (needle, throttle, flow divider and divider-combiner, flow fuse and modulating spool), load holding (counterbalance, pilot-to-open check, LoadAdaptive and LoadMatch load control), directional valves (check, logic element, shuttle, diverter and 2-, 3-, 4- and 6-way types), electro-proportional valves, solenoid operated valves including balanced and unbalanced poppet and CavitySaver multi-function types, and specialty products such as accumulator sense and pump unload valves, hand pumps, air bleed and start-up valves, cavity plugs, converters and filters. Several ranges are identified by name on the site, including the FLeX Series, the 0-Series counterbalance valves, the ENERGEN energy harvester cartridge valve and the eSense electro-hydraulic product.

Alongside its products the company publishes technical resources including explanations of Sun model and date codes, and offers QuickDesign, described on the site as a tool that streamlines the custom manifold design process. Sun states that it works with customers on cartridges offering special functionality. Its website lists locations in Sarasota, Florida (USA), Coventry in the United Kingdom, Erkelenz in Germany, Incheon in Korea, Shanghai in China and Pune in India, and the site footer carries the copyright of Sun Hydraulics LLC.

profiles.shortDescription: Swedish Neutral AB develops, manufactures and markets systems for neutral treatment and earth fault protection for medium and high voltage networks. Its range covers the Ground Fault Neutralizer earth fault protection system, an active Fault Passage Indicator, arc suppression coils, automatic tuning devices, earth fault locators, grounding transformers and neutral earthing resistors. Customers are electrical utilities, industrial plants such as steel mills and mines, and infrastructure operators such as railways.
fullDescription: Swedish Neutral AB, established in 1987, develops, manufactures and markets systems for neutral treatment and earth fault protection that raise reliability and safety for medium and high voltage networks. The company states that its customers include electrical utilities, industries such as steel mills and mines, and infrastructure customers such as railways. Its main office is at Mätarvägen 12, S-196 37 Kungsängen, Sweden, and the company describes its quality work as ISO 9001 certified.

The core product is the Ground Fault Neutralizer (GFN), described as an active earth fault protection system for distribution and transmission networks that detects and locates earth faults and eliminates the earth fault current using power electronics faster than a breaker can trip the fault. The company publishes the performance figures for this class of protection: earth fault impedance detection and localisation over 0-25 kΩ, fault current held below 500 mA for locating purposes, and fault current eliminated within 85 ms. Swedish Neutral states that the GFN performance created the protection class known as REFCL (Rapid Earth Fault Current Limiter), used for bushfire mitigation in Australia and wildfire mitigation in the USA.

Alongside the GFN, Swedish Neutral offers a complete program of standard neutral devices. The active Fault Passage Indicator pinpoints an earth fault down to the faulty network section even at very high fault impedance; the Automatic Tuning Device continuously monitors the network and tunes the arc suppression coil to minimise capacitive earth fault current; arc suppression coils are connected to the transformer neutral for resonance grounding; the Earth Fault Locator provides feeder indication in resonance and other high impedance grounded networks; grounding transformers provide a physical neutral for delta-connected power transformers; and neutral earthing resistors generate the active current that some protection relays need to detect earth faults. The company sells directly to end customers and works with distribution partners in Europe, Australasia and the USA.

profiles.shortDescription: SWR engineering is the bulk solids process instrumentation brand manufactured by ENVEA Process GmbH in Schliengen, Germany. It makes online measuring systems for solids handling: mass flow and velocity measurement in pneumatic conveying and free fall, flow/no-flow and blockage detection, point level monitoring, residual moisture measurement and dust measurement after filters. Sensors are combined with MSE 300 evaluation units in DIN rail or field housings and output 4-20 mA, Modbus or Profibus signals.
fullDescription: The SWR engineering product line is published on the manufacturer's own site, envea.global, and the brand name is still carried in current ENVEA documentation. The SolidFlow 2.0 operating instructions hosted there state that "An RS 485 to USB adapter can be purchased from envea™ - SWR engineering", and the warranty section says defective components are replaced or repaired at ENVEA SWR engineering's plant. The same manual gives the manufacturer imprint: ENVEA Process GmbH, Gutedelstraße 31, 79418 Schliengen, Germany.

The flagship instrument, SolidFlow 2.0, is described as a measuring system specially developed for measuring the quantity of solids conveyed in pipelines. The sensor works with microwave technology and is used only in metallic pipelines, where the integration of the microwave field with the pipe creates a homogeneous measurement field; microwave radiation is reflected by the solid particles, and frequency-selective evaluation ensures that only moving particles are measured while deposits are suppressed. Published data include throughput up to 20 t/h, material up to 20 mm grain size, process pressure 1 bar (optionally 10 bar), process temperature up to +200 °C (optionally up to +900 °C), pipe diameters up to 800 mm, ATEX category 1/2 rating, and 4-20 mA, Modbus and Profibus outputs. Installation is by weld-on socket, with two sensors offset by 90° from 300 mm pipe diameter and three sensors offset by 120° from 400 mm.

The wider range on envea.global covers MaxxFlow HTC for mass flow of dry bulk solids, PicoFlow for flow measurement at low solid/air ratios, DensFlow for dense-phase conveying, SpeedFlow 2.0 for solids velocity, the FlowJam family (FlowJam, FlowJam Plus, FlowJam S, FlowJam T) for continuous material flow detection and blockage monitoring, SlideControl 2.0 for flow monitoring on air slides, ProGap 2.0 for point level monitoring, ProSens for dust measurement after filters, and the M-Sens moisture sensors (M-Sens 2, M-Sens 3, M-Sens NIR, M-Sens WR3). The SolidFlow 2.0 page lists main applications including biomass, cement, chemistry, coal plants, coating, food, incineration, minerals, wood, lime plants, energy, gypsum, power plants and foundries.

profiles.shortDescription: Sylvania Group manufactures and markets lighting solutions for professional and consumer use. Its offer covers technical and connected luminaires, lamps, lighting control and digital lighting services, sold under two brands: Sylvania for offices, education, industry, logistics and hospitality, and Concord for architectural lighting in galleries, museums and retail. The group states that it operates European production sites.
fullDescription: Sylvania Group states on its own About Us page that it manufactures and markets eco-responsible and digital lighting solutions, and that it is present in more than 50 countries with 1,200 employees and over 120 years of expertise. The company describes its European production sites as enabling it to provide both standard and customised solutions while limiting its carbon footprint, and notes that it was awarded EcoVadis Silver status in 2024.

The group's expertise is built on two brands it describes as historic. Sylvania, the flagship brand, addresses offices and education, industry and logistics, and the hospitality sector, combining performance, range breadth and eco-responsibility. Concord is dedicated to architectural lighting for galleries, museums and retail outlets, and the company states its products have been recognised for design and technical performance for over 60 years. The site organises the professional offer around applications including education, logistics and industry, museums and galleries, retail display, healthcare, hospitality, outdoor and residential lighting, together with specific applications such as grow lights, insect control and swimming pool lighting.

Alongside luminaires and lamps, the company publishes digital solutions and services under the SylSmart name, including SylSmart Connected Pro and SylSmart Energy, and states that it supports customers throughout their projects with a comprehensive range of services. For professionals it offers technical and connected luminaires intended for energy savings; for consumers it offers high-performance, solar-powered and connected products for the home and garden. On corporate identity the site states that Sylvania Group, whose legal entity is FEILO Sylvania, is owned by INESA (Group) Co. Limited, based in Shanghai, China.

profiles.shortDescription: TB Wood's designs and manufactures industrial couplings and belted drive solutions. Its products include Sure-Flex Plus and Dura-Flex elastomeric couplings, Form-Flex disc couplings, G-Flex grid couplings and jaw couplings, plus V-belt sheaves, synchronous sprockets, made-to-order sheaves, belted mechanical variable speed drives, belts and bushings. The company also runs its own foundry producing gray and ductile iron castings, and is based in Chambersburg, Pennsylvania, USA.
fullDescription: Founded in 1857, TB Wood's states that it has grown to become a global leader in the design and manufacture of industrial couplings and belted drive solutions. Its coupling products include the Sure-Flex Plus and Dura-Flex elastomeric couplings, Form-Flex disc couplings, G-Flex grid couplings and jaw couplings, which the company describes as highly engineered and built to ensure long-lasting performance. The company's contact details place it at 440 North Fifth Avenue, Chambersburg, PA 17201, USA, and its site states that TB Wood's is now part of Regal Rexnord.

The belted drive range covers V-belt sheaves, synchronous sprockets, made-to-order sheaves, belted mechanical variable speed drives, belts and bushings. TB Wood's states that all of its sheaves are constructed of fine grain, high tensile cast iron and are engineered for long life, and it publishes a made-to-order sheave programme in which an integrated foundry with machining enables response time for made-to-order products. The product menu also lists clutches and brakes and a hydrostatic speed variator.

TB Wood's operates its own foundry, stating that its foundry operations are capable of producing gray and ductile iron parts up to 10,000 lbs per cast part, with complete-to-print capabilities and a delivery system that lets it satisfy most casting requirements on time and on budget; commercial castings are offered as a separate product line. The company publishes selector programs, an eCatalog with 3D drawings for Form-Flex AP, GP, A5 and G5 series couplings, and application support from its factory, and it sells through authorized distributors. Its listed key markets include bridge and dam, crane and hoist, elevator and escalator, farm and agriculture, food and beverage, forestry, marine, material handling, metal processing and shredding, mining and aggregate, off-highway and construction, oil and gas, package machinery, power generation, pumps and wastewater.

profiles.shortDescription: TE Connectivity designs and manufactures electrical parts and electronic components, in particular connectors, terminals and splices, relays and contactors, switches, cable assemblies, antennas, heat shrink tubing and wire protection hardware. Its sensor line covers pressure, temperature, position, force, torque, speed, flow, humidity, vibration and gas detection measurement, together with DAQ systems and scanners. The components are supplied to end markets including automotive, industrial machinery, aerospace and defence, rail, energy, medical technologies, data centres and personal electronics.
fullDescription: TE Connectivity describes itself on its About TE page as a global manufacturer of optimally engineered electrical parts and electronic components. The company states that it designs and manufactures the connectivity and sensor solutions used in electric vehicles and renewable energy systems, interventional medical devices and factory robotics, and smart power grids and the global communications infrastructure, and that it empowers engineers by designing and manufacturing sensor and connectivity solutions for an increasingly connected world.

The product portfolio published on te.com is organised into connectors of many types (circular, rectangular, PCB, RF, fiber optic, D-shaped, power, automotive and high-speed pluggable IO), terminals and splices, contacts, terminal blocks and strips, relays and contactors, circuit breakers, switches, passive components such as inductors and resistors, antennas, cable assemblies, wire and cable, heat shrink tubing, EMI and EMC solutions, identification and labelling products, fiber optics, medical device components, and wire protection and management hardware including cable glands, conduit and wiring ducts. The sensor category lists pressure, temperature, position, force, torque, speed, mass air flow, flow, fluid property, humidity, optical, piezo film, proximity, ultrasonic, vibration, rate and inertial, traffic and gas detection sensors, plus DAQ systems and scanners and sensor development boards. TE also lists application tooling for processing these components, such as applicators, hand crimping tools, benchtop crimping machines and insertion and extraction tools.

The site groups its offer by end market, listing automotive, commercial and industrial vehicles, e-mobility, autosport, industrial machinery, automation and control, aerospace, defense and military, space, rail, energy solutions, oil and gas and marine, medical technologies, data centers and artificial intelligence, 5G and wireless equipment, IoT connectivity, intelligent buildings and smart cities, connected home and smart appliances, and personal electronics and wearable technology. Products are sold under a set of TE brands named on the site, among them AMP, DEUTSCH, RAYCHEM, Potter & Brumfield, Schrack, ENTRELEC, ERNI, Agastat, Alcoswitch, Measurement Specialties and First Sensor. TE states that for more than 80 years its engineers and product specialists have partnered with customers to advance innovation in industrial technologies.

profiles.shortDescription: Teaflex S.p.A. manufactures, distributes and sells polyamide and metallic flexible conduits, galvanized tubes, fittings, cable glands and accessories for the protection and safety of electrical cables. Its catalogue is organised into pipes, sheaths, fittings, cable glands, boxes, tools and accessories, grouped as polyamide, metal and PVC protection systems. The products are applied in railway installations, machine tools, shipbuilding, and automation and robotics.
fullDescription: Teaflex states on its own site that the company was born in 1972 and is an internationally recognised Italian manufacturer, distributor and seller of polyamide and metallic flexible conduits, galvanized tubes, fittings, cable glands and accessories for the protection and safety of electrical cables. The company is based at Via delle Vigne 28, Biassono, in Italy.

The catalogue published on teaflex.it is divided into seven groups: pipes, sheaths, fittings, cable glands, boxes, tools and accessories. Across these groups the site presents three protection systems by material — polyamide protective systems, metal protection systems and PVC protection systems — so that conduits, sheaths, fittings and glands can be combined into a complete cable protection assembly.

The applications named on the site are railway installations, machine tools, shipbuilding, and automation and robotics, and the company also identifies electrical material distribution and design studios among the audiences it serves. The site references ISO 9001 certification for the company.

profiles.shortDescription: TechnipFMC develops, engineers, manufactures and installs subsea systems for the energy industry, including umbilicals, rigid pipelines, flexible pipes, connections and tie-ins. Its subsea portfolio also covers well and flow control equipment, subsea processing systems for separation, boosting and compression, and subsea controls and automation. The company additionally supplies surface technologies for onshore and shallow-water markets, from the well to the export pipeline.
fullDescription: TechnipFMC presents itself on its own site as a technology provider to the traditional and new energy industries. Its subsea business designs integrated subsea systems with cost reduction in mind and covers engineering, manufacturing, installation, life of field services and project execution. The company states that its engineers have been developing subsea technology since the 1970s and that it has engineered and supplied subsea solutions for more than 40 years.

For subsea infrastructure, the company states that it develops, engineers, manufactures and installs umbilicals, rigid pipelines and flexible pipes, connections and tie-ins for subsea systems — the subsea umbilicals, risers and flowlines scope. Its Subsea 2.0 configurable product platform consists of pre-engineered products assembled from standardised components in a modular architecture, which the company describes as a configured-to-order execution model intended to give zero project engineering, repeatable manufacturing and supply chain quality, and predictable deliveries. Subsea processing covers separation, boosting and compression solutions in both greenfield and brownfield applications, and the portfolio also includes well and flow control equipment and subsea controls and automation.

Alongside subsea, the site describes a Surface business serving the onshore and shallow water markets from well to export pipeline, with pressure control, production, wellheads and trees and shallow water iEPCI, and a Robotics line of ROV systems and manipulator systems. Life of field services listed include iLOF Services, subsea drilling services, asset management, field performance services, inspection, maintenance and repair, and Pivotal Riserless Intervention. A New Energy section covers greenhouse gas removal, offshore floating renewables and a Dynamic Inter Array Cable System.

profiles.shortDescription: Tekno Stamap s.r.l. designs, develops and manufactures dough-processing machinery and systems for the bakery and pastry industries. Its range covers planetary mixers, manual and automatic dough sheeters, bread moulders, pastry refiners, croissant machines, spiral and two-arm mixers, and industrial make-up lines for bread, pizza and pastry. The company states that its customers are mainly resellers and producers from large restaurant services.
fullDescription: Tekno Stamap s.r.l. states on its own site that it designs, develops and manufactures dough-processing systems and machinery for the bakery and pastry industries. The company says it was founded in 1982 by Antonio Baldovin and Remigio Dante, that manual and automatic dough sheeters and planetary mixers still constitute the core of its production, and that croissant machines and make-up lines for bread, pizza and pastries were added to the range later. It is based at Tretti Marotti 4, Grisignano di Zocco, in the province of Vicenza, Italy.

The company describes an autonomous production line: it states that it manufactures almost all machine components internally and that the design, development and assembling phases are carried out entirely within its own plants. Every single machine is thoroughly tested and proven before packaging and shipping, with duration tests added to final functional tests, so that the customer only has to make the connections and start the production line. The site states that all components are certified Made in Italy and Made in EU, that all machine parts in contact with food are coated in nontoxic paint certified for food use, and that a photovoltaic system largely covers the plant's internal energy needs.

The catalogue is grouped into planetary mixers, manual sheeters, automatic sheeters, bread moulders, pastry refiners, croissant machines, industrial lines and mixers, the last including fixed bowl spiral mixers and two arm mixers. Model names printed on the site include C-LINE 2, TK2 and TK 160/200 among the planetary mixers, SMART, INDUSTRIAL SMART, AUTOSMART and AUTOSMART 123 among the automatic sheeters, and CROYMAT for croissant machines. Applications are presented by sector as pizza, confectionery and bread.

profiles.shortDescription: Televac is the vacuum measurement brand of The Fredericks Company, which designs and manufactures vacuum gauges, sensors and vacuum controllers. The range covers thermocouple, convection (Pirani) and piezo diaphragm gauges for low vacuum and cold cathode and hot ion gauges for high vacuum, together with single-channel, multi-channel, portable and active controllers spanning 10-11 Torr to 10,000 Torr. The instruments are used in vacuum furnaces and heat treating, semiconductor and thin film deposition equipment, cryogenics and industrial gas, vacuum distillation and research laboratories.
fullDescription: The Fredericks Company states that its Televac vacuum measurement brand designs and manufactures single channel and multi-channel vacuum controllers for use with its own passive gauges, including thermocouple gauges, convection gauges and diaphragm gauges for low vacuum measurement, and cold cathode gauges and hot ion gauges for high vacuum measurement. The same statement is repeated for the portable controllers, the active gauges and the passive gauges and transducers, so the whole Televac line is presented as designed and manufactured in house. The company is located at 2400 Philmont Avenue, Huntingdon Valley, Pennsylvania.

The controllers listed are the multi-channel MX200, which connects to up to ten passive gauges for a measurement range of 10-11 Torr to 10,000 Torr, and the single-channel MV2A and Compact 2A. Portable, battery-powered controllers VacuGuard and B2A Portable read a single thermocouple gauge from 10-3 Torr to 20 Torr. Active gauges MX2A, MX4A, MX7B, MX7M and CC-10 combine a passive sensor and its controlling electronics in one unit with OLED displays, touch controls and RS-485 communications. Passive gauges include the 2A, 2V6 and 4A thermocouple and convection types, the 1E piezo diaphragm, and the 7B, 7E, 7F, 7FC and 7FCS cold cathode magnetron gauges, alongside ETI hot ion Bayard-Alpert gauges and filaments. The controllers provide analog 0 to 10 V DC outputs per connected gauge, RS-232, RS-485, PROFINET, EthernetIP and USB communications, and set point relays for process control.

The markets named on the site for Televac vacuum measurement are vacuum furnaces and heat treating, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, thin film deposition, vacuum distillation, e-beam welding, freeze dryers, liquefied natural gas, industrial gas and cryogenics, medical particle accelerators, vacuum glove boxes, and national labs and research and development. The company also offers ISO 17025 accredited, NIST traceable and factory calibration and repair services for these instruments, and publishes documentation, 3D STEP models, a product selection guide and measurement conversion tools. Its certifications are listed as ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17025:2017.

profiles.shortDescription: TOCINA manufactures cast steel and forged steel industrial valves. Its range covers gate valves, globe valves and swing check valves in ASME classes 150 to 2500, designed to ASME B16.34, API 600, API 602, ISO 10434, BS 1414, BS 1873, BS 1868, BS 5352 and EN ISO 15761. The valves are supplied with EN 10204 3.1 certification and carry the CE mark under the Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU.
fullDescription: TOCINA describes itself on its own site as a maker of cast and forged steel valves, under the banner "LEADERS IN QUALITY CAST & FORGED STEEL VALVES". The About text states: "Behind the brand name TOCINA, is an experienced and highly qualified group of specialists who turn the departments of quality, engineering, sales and finance into the real driving force of the company", and that "With over 35 years within the valve industry, TOCINA has become a recognized, registered and approved product." The site names the legal entity Tocina Válvulas S.L. in both its copyright line and its quality policy.

The published catalogue covers three valve types, each offered in cast steel and forged steel and in classes 150, 300, 600, 800, 900, 1500 and 2500. Gate valves are bolted bonnet, flexible wedge, OS&Y rising stem designs to ASME B16.34, API 600, ISO 10434 and BS 1414, with forged versions to API 602, BS 5352 and EN ISO 15761 using bolted, welded or pressure-sealed bonnets and a solid wedge. Globe valves are bolted bonnet with renewable disc and seat to ASME B16.34 and BS 1873, and swing check valves are bolted cover designs to ASME B16.34, BS 1868, API 6D/ISO 14313 and MSS SP-42. Face-to-face dimensions follow ASME B16.10 and ISO 5752, flanges ASME B16.5 RF (RTJ on request) and butt weld ends ASME B16.25.

Trim and seat materials are stated to meet API 600 / ISO 10434 trim numbers 1 up to 14A and NACE in its latest revision. Testing is to API 598, BS 6755 Part 1, ISO 5208, EN 12266 and MSS SP-61, with EN 10204 / DIN 50 049 3.1 certification as standard and 3.1.C, API 600 or special requirements available on request. The company states that its quality system, processes and procedures are "certified according to the EN ISO 9001 - 2015 standard & Pressure Equipment Directive 2014/68/EU", and that "all valves produced by TOCINA are supplied with CE mark (where required) and CE declaration of conformity"; copies of the ISO 9001 and PED certificates are published on the site.

profiles.shortDescription: Twiflex manufactures industrial disc braking systems, clutch couplings, flexible couplings and shaft assemblies for power transmission applications. Its spring-applied brake calipers can be retracted pneumatically, hydraulically or electrically, while direct-acting brakes use positive retraction devices. The company also supplies integrated turning, locking and braking systems and sells calipers directly through its own eStore.
fullDescription: Twiflex presents itself on its own site as a manufacturer of industrial braking and power transmission components, under the page title "Industrial Disc Brake Calipers & Advanced Braking Solutions". Of its core range it states: "Twiflex offers the largest range of industrial disc brake calipers in the world. Spring applied units may be retracted pneumatically, hydraulically or electrically (depending on caliper design) while most direct acting brakes have some form of positive retraction device." Complete braking packages are offered alongside individual calipers, and marine power transmission solutions are highlighted on the homepage.

The coupling side of the portfolio is described in the company's own words: "Twiflex manufactures a range of torsionally flexible, rubber element couplings for a range of duties. Sometimes combined with a brake disc, they are a critical interface between components of a transmission system." For shafting, the site states that Multi-Point shaft assemblies, including the fixed length configuration, can accommodate axial movement as well as radial and angular misalignments, that there are no wearing parts and no bearings because the shafts are self-supported, and that couplings may be supplied with UJ or CV type joints to provide more torsional flexibility than a traditional shaft assembly, or to reduce transmitted noise and provide damping. Twiflex engineers are stated to be available to discuss, analyse and advise on coupling suitability and to provide technical support.

A fourth product line combines the others: the site explains that when purchasing a complete turning gear system integrated with locking and braking from Altra, customers can consolidate three separate interfaces into one multi-functional solution — Turning 'T', Locking 'L' and Braking 'B' — saving dimensional space and reducing installation and maintenance time. Supporting resources published on the site include Twiflex catalogs, brochures and service manuals, braking calculations, a distributor locator, an eStore for pneumatically, hydraulically and mechanically applied disc brake calipers, and an ISO 9001:2015 certificate. The footer gives the company as Twiflex Ltd, 317-319 Ampthill Road, Bedford, MK42 9RD, UK, and carries the copyright line of Regal Rexnord.

profiles.shortDescription: Valpes manufactures electric actuators for valve automation, stating its purpose as automating all types of valves for all kinds of fluid. Its range covers quarter-turn and multiturn actuators from 10 to 2400 Nm, including low-temperature, ATEX, DNV, marine and battery-backup versions, with IP65 to IP68 protection. All actuators are manufactured, assembled and tested at the company's 1,500 square metre plant in Moirans near Grenoble, France.
fullDescription: On its own company page Valpes states that it was founded in 1986 and is nowadays part of the Watts Water Technologies Group, which it says gives it a worldwide presence to offer a range of products in line with market expectations. Its stated purpose is "to automate all types of valves for all kinds of fluid". The footer names the legal entity as WATTS AUTOMATION – VALPES S.A.S. at Z.I. Centr'alp, 89 rue des étangs, 38430 Moirans, France, and directs enquiries for pneumatic actuators and automation to its sister company BAR GmbH.

Production is concentrated on a single site: the company states that its 1,500 square metre plant in Moirans, near Grenoble, manufactures, assembles and tests all of its electric actuators, and that the production plant meets ISO 9001, ATEX, IECEx, CSA/UL, EAC and EACEx requirements. A typical unit is described as a 90° electric actuator with PA6 housing to UL 94-V0 and a secured manual override, for torques of 10, 20, 35, 60 and 100 Nm, in accordance with the CE, RoHS and REACH directives.

The published catalogue is organised into named ranges. Quarter-turn actuators include ER PLUS (10 to 100 Nm, IP68 1.2 m / 30 min), ER PREMIER (20 to 100 Nm, IP65), VR (25 to 75 Nm, IP68 up to 5 m / 72 h), VS (40 to 300 Nm, IP68 up to 10 m / 72 h) and LT for low temperatures down to -50 °C (25 to 300 Nm). High-torque quarter-turn units are the VT (600 to 2400 Nm) and VT PLUS (400 to 2400 Nm), while MT covers multiturn actuators from 25 to 75 Nm. Certified variants include DV (DNV-certified, 25 to 1000 Nm), DVX (DNV and ATEX, 25 to 300 Nm) and the ATEX range VRX, VSX, VTX and VTX+ spanning 25 to 2400 Nm with CE, EAC, ATEX, UKEX and IECEx approvals; MARINE versions are offered for corrosive atmospheres. Options listed on the same page include BBPR actuators with an integrated battery backup position recovery unit (10 to 2400 Nm), POSI positioning versions accepting 0-10 V and 4-20 mA signals (20 to 2400 Nm), 3 POSITIONS versions with an intermediate position between 0° and 90°, combined POSI-BBPR and 3-POSITIONS-BBPR units, and Bluetooth and Modbus-RTU connectivity powered by AXMART.

profiles.shortDescription: Waters Corporation develops and manufactures analytical instruments, columns and consumables for laboratory science, centred on liquid chromatography and mass spectrometry systems, detectors, ion sources, light scattering instruments and particle analyzers. The company also supplies laboratory informatics and software, in vitro diagnostics solutions and instrument service. Its customers work in regulated, high-volume testing environments such as pharmaceutical development, food and water safety testing and clinical diagnostics.
fullDescription: Waters Corporation describes itself on its own corporate pages as a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics and service. The company states that it works with customers to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, to ensure the safety of food and water, and to drive better patient outcomes. Its corporate address is given as 34 Maple Street, Milford, MA 01757, and its shares trade on the NYSE under the ticker WAT.

The company's product directory groups its offering into chromatography, mass spectrometry, informatics and software, in vitro diagnostics solutions, light scattering instruments and systems, and particle analyzers. Within chromatography Waters lists columns, detectors, preparative solutions, software and complete systems; within mass spectrometry it lists direct analysis products, ion sources, software and systems. Together these lines cover both the instruments themselves and the columns, consumables and data systems used to operate them.

Waters presents its business as an ecosystem of instruments, informatics, consumables and service, and says that more than 70 percent of its revenue is annually recurring. It positions itself in regulated, high-volume applications, naming pharmaceutical quality assurance and quality control together with clinical and advanced diagnostic workflows as the areas in which its technologies are embedded. Roughly ten percent of sales is reported as reinvested in research and development.

profiles.shortDescription: Watlow Electric Manufacturing Company designs and manufactures electric resistive heaters, temperature sensors, temperature and power controllers and supporting software, covering all the components of a thermal system. Its catalogue spans cartridge, tubular, immersion, circulation, band, flexible, radiant and high-temperature heaters, thermocouples and RTDs, power controllers, control panels and integrated thermal platforms. The company supplies industrial and equipment builders in fields such as semiconductor processing, energy generation, medical and analytical instruments and foodservice equipment.
fullDescription: Watlow states on its own site that it designs and manufactures heating solutions consisting primarily of electric resistive heaters, temperature sensors, temperature and power controllers and supporting software - all the components of a thermal system. The company organises this offering around what it calls the thermal loop, in which the heater, the sensor that measures the process and the controller that regulates power are treated as one engineered system rather than separate parts.

The heater catalogue is published by type and includes air heaters, band and barrel heaters, cartridge insertion heaters, circulation heaters, flexible heaters, fluid delivery heaters, high-temperature heaters, immersion heaters, gas delivery and exhaust heaters, nozzle heaters, radiant heaters, specialty heaters, strip and clamp-on heaters and tubular heaters. Named product lines shown alongside these types include FIREROD cartridge heaters, WATROD and FINBAR heaters, ULTRAMIC advanced ceramic heaters, MULTICELL insertion cartridge heaters, FLUENT in-line heaters, HELIMAX electric heat exchangers, the POWERSAFE medium voltage integrated platform, ASSURANT types and STRETCH-TO-LENGTH heaters, together with the LDH SERIES and D SERIES duct heaters.

Beyond heaters, the site lists temperature and process control products such as single-loop and multi-loop controllers, indicators, alarms, limits, scanners and operator interfaces, along with power controllers and power switches, data recorders, sensors including thermocouples, RTDs and fibre optic sensing, and control panels and integrated systems. Markets named on Watlow's own pages include semiconductor processing, aerospace and defence, data centre solutions, medical devices, biopharma, analytical instruments, life sciences, clinical equipment, refining, paper and pulp, gypsum production and foodservice equipment. Site pages carry the legal-entity line Watlow Electric Manufacturing Company.
